lines.en: We sing and dance.
lines.zh: 我们唱歌跳舞。

lines.en: Then we eat cake and candy.
lines.zh: 然后我们吃蛋糕和糖果。

lines.en: We are very happy.
lines.zh: 我们非常开心。

lines.en: What do you do on this day?
lines.zh: 这一天你做什么？

patterns.en: We sing at the party.
patterns.zh: 我们在派对上唱歌。

patterns.en: We dance at the party.
patterns.zh: 我们在派对上跳舞。

patterns.en: We play games at the party.
patterns.zh: 我们在派对上玩游戏。

patterns.en: We eat cake at the party.
patterns.zh: 我们在派对上吃蛋糕。

lines.en: Today is my birthday.
lines.zh: 今天是我的生日。

lines.en: I am eight now.
lines.zh: 我八岁了。

lines.en: Mom gives me a cake.
lines.zh: 妈妈给我一个蛋糕。

lines.en: It is sweet and good.
lines.zh: 它又甜又好吃。

lines.en: My friends come to see me.
lines.zh: 朋友们来看我。

lines.en: They give me presents.
lines.zh: 他们送我礼物。

lines.en: I am very happy.
lines.zh: 我非常开心。

lines.en: When is your birthday?
lines.zh: 你的生日是什么时候？

patterns.en: Today is my birthday. I'm six.
patterns.zh: 今天是我的生日。我六岁了。

patterns.en: Today is my birthday. I'm seven.
patterns.zh: 今天是我的生日。我七岁了。

patterns.en: Today is my birthday. I'm eight.
patterns.zh: 今天是我的生日。我八岁了。

patterns.en: Today is my birthday. I'm nine.
patterns.zh: 今天是我的生日。我九岁了。

lines.en: It is Mid-Autumn Festival.
lines.zh: 中秋节到了。

lines.en: My family is together.
lines.zh: 我们一家人团聚在一起。

lines.en: At night, we look at the moon.
lines.zh: 晚上，我们一起赏月。

lines.en: It is big and round.
lines.zh: 月亮又大又圆。

lines.en: We eat mooncakes, too.
lines.zh: 我们还吃月饼。

lines.en: They are sweet.
lines.zh: 月饼甜甜的。

lines.en: I love this festival.
lines.zh: 我爱这个节日。

lines.en: Do you like mooncakes?
lines.zh: 你喜欢月饼吗？

patterns.en: We look at the moon. It's round.
patterns.zh: 我们赏月。月亮圆圆的。

patterns.en: We look at the moon. It's bright.
patterns.zh: 我们赏月。月亮亮亮的。

patterns.en: We look at the stars. They're bright.
patterns.zh: 我们看星星。星星亮亮的。

patterns.en: We eat mooncakes. They're sweet.
patterns.zh: 我们吃月饼。月饼甜甜的。

lines.en: I am big now.
lines.zh: 我长大了。

lines.en: So I can help at home.
lines.zh: 所以我能在家帮忙。

lines.en: I clean my room.
lines.zh: 我打扫我的房间。

lines.en: I wash the cups.
lines.zh: 我洗杯子。

lines.en: I feed my cat, too.
lines.zh: 我还喂我的猫。

lines.en: Mom smiles at me.
lines.zh: 妈妈对我笑。

lines.en: I am a good helper.
lines.zh: 我是个好帮手。

lines.en: How do you help at home?
lines.zh: 你在家怎么帮忙？

patterns.en: I can clean my room.
patterns.zh: 我会打扫我的房间。

patterns.en: I can wash the cups.
patterns.zh: 我会洗杯子。

patterns.en: I can feed the cat.
patterns.zh: 我会喂猫。

patterns.en: I can water the flowers.
patterns.zh: 我会给花浇水。

lines.en: There are five people in my family.
lines.zh: 我家有五口人。

lines.en: Every evening, we are all at home together.
lines.zh: 每天晚上，我们都一起待在家里。

lines.en: My dad can cook very well, so he makes dinner.
lines.zh: 爸爸做饭很好吃，所以晚饭由他来做。

lines.en: My mom is a teacher, so she helps me.
lines.zh: 妈妈是老师，所以她辅导我学习。

lines.en: My big sister reads books by the window.
lines.zh: 姐姐坐在窗边看书。

lines.en: Our baby brother sits on the floor and laughs.
lines.zh: 小弟弟坐在地板上咯咯地笑。

lines.en: After dinner, we all sit together and talk.
lines.zh: 吃完晚饭，我们坐在一起聊天。

lines.en: Then my mom sings a song for us.
lines.zh: 然后妈妈给我们唱一首歌。

lines.en: I love my family, and they love me.
lines.zh: 我爱我的家人，他们也爱我。

lines.en: How many people are there in your family?
lines.zh: 你家有几口人？

patterns.en: Who is he? He's my dad.
patterns.zh: 他是谁？他是我爸爸。

patterns.en: Who is she? She's my mom.
patterns.zh: 她是谁？她是我妈妈。

patterns.en: Who is she? She's my sister.
patterns.zh: 她是谁？她是我姐姐。

patterns.en: Who is he? He's my brother.
patterns.zh: 他是谁？他是我弟弟。

patterns.en: Who is he? He's my grandpa.
patterns.zh: 他是谁？他是我爷爷。

lines.en: I like the weekend, because there is no school.
lines.zh: 我喜欢周末，因为不用上学。

lines.en: On Saturday morning, I play ball with my friends.
lines.zh: 星期六上午，我和朋友们一起玩球。

lines.en: After that, we are tired and hungry.
lines.zh: 玩完以后，我们又累又饿。

lines.en: So we go to my house for lunch.
lines.zh: 所以我们去我家吃午饭。

lines.en: On Sunday, my mother takes me to the library.
lines.zh: 星期天，妈妈带我去图书馆。

lines.en: There are books about animals and stars there.
lines.zh: 那里有关于动物和星星的书。

lines.en: I take some books home with me.
lines.zh: 我借几本书带回家。

lines.en: At night, I read them in bed.
lines.zh: 晚上，我躺在床上看这些书。

lines.en: The weekend is a happy time for me.
lines.zh: 周末对我来说是快乐的时光。

lines.en: What do you do on the weekend?
lines.zh: 你周末做什么？

patterns.en: What do you do on Saturday? I play ball.
patterns.zh: 你星期六做什么？我玩球。

patterns.en: What do you do on Saturday? I go swimming.
patterns.zh: 你星期六做什么？我去游泳。

patterns.en: What do you do on Sunday? I go to the library.
patterns.zh: 你星期天做什么？我去图书馆。

patterns.en: What do you do on Sunday? I help my mother.
patterns.zh: 你星期天做什么？我帮妈妈干活。

patterns.en: What do you do on Sunday? I paint pictures.
patterns.zh: 你星期天做什么？我画画。

lines.en: It is Saturday morning, and my family is busy.
lines.zh: 今天是星期六早上，我们一家人都很忙。

lines.en: We are cleaning the house together.
lines.zh: 我们正在一起打扫房子。

lines.en: My father is washing the windows.
lines.zh: 爸爸在擦窗户。

lines.en: My mother is cleaning the floor.
lines.zh: 妈妈在拖地。

lines.en: My sister is putting her books on the shelf.
lines.zh: 妹妹在把她的书放到书架上。

lines.en: And I am washing the cups and plates.
lines.zh: 我呢，在洗杯子和盘子。

lines.en: There is water on my shirt, but I don't mind.
lines.zh: 我的衬衫上溅了水，但是我不在意。

lines.en: At last, our house is clean and bright.
lines.zh: 最后，我们的房子变得又干净又明亮。

lines.en: I am happy, because I can help my family.
lines.zh: 我很开心，因为我能帮家人做事。

lines.en: Do you help at home?
lines.zh: 你在家帮忙做家务吗？

patterns.en: How do you help at home? I wash the plates.
patterns.zh: 你在家怎么帮忙？我洗盘子。

patterns.en: How do you help at home? I clean the floor.
patterns.zh: 你在家怎么帮忙？我拖地。

patterns.en: How do you help at home? I make my bed.
patterns.zh: 你在家怎么帮忙？我整理床铺。

patterns.en: How do you help at home? I give the plants water.
patterns.zh: 你在家怎么帮忙？我给植物浇水。

patterns.en: How do you help at home? I put my books on the shelf.
patterns.zh: 你在家怎么帮忙？我把书放到书架上。

lines.en: Last Sunday, I went to the park with my family.
lines.zh: 上个星期天，我和家人去了公园。

lines.en: The weather was warm and bright.
lines.zh: 天气暖和又晴朗。

lines.en: First, we walked by the river.
lines.zh: 我们先在河边散步。

lines.en: I saw some fish in the water.
lines.zh: 我看到水里有一些鱼。

lines.en: Then my father played ball with me on the grass.
lines.zh: 然后爸爸在草地上陪我玩球。

lines.en: After that, we were all hungry.
lines.zh: 玩完以后，我们都饿了。

lines.en: So we had the bread and fruit from my mother.
lines.zh: 于是我们吃了妈妈带来的面包和水果。

lines.en: We were tired, but we were very happy.
lines.zh: 我们很累，但是非常开心。

lines.en: It was a happy Sunday.
lines.zh: 那是一个快乐的星期天。

lines.en: What did you do last Sunday?
lines.zh: 你上个星期天做了什么？

patterns.en: What did you do last Sunday? I played ball.
patterns.zh: 你上个星期天做了什么？我玩了球。

patterns.en: What did you do last Sunday? I went to the park.
patterns.zh: 你上个星期天做了什么？我去了公园。

patterns.en: What did you do last Sunday? I went swimming.
patterns.zh: 你上个星期天做了什么？我去游泳了。

patterns.en: What did you do last Sunday? I cooked with my father.
patterns.zh: 你上个星期天做了什么？我和爸爸一起做饭了。

patterns.en: What did you do last Sunday? I painted a picture.
patterns.zh: 你上个星期天做了什么？我画了一幅画。

lines.en: When I was small, I could not walk.
lines.zh: 我小时候还不会走路。

lines.en: So my mother had me in her arms all day.
lines.zh: 所以妈妈整天把我抱在怀里。

lines.en: I could not talk, but I could cry.
lines.zh: 我不会说话，但是我会哭。

lines.en: When I cried, my father played music for me.
lines.zh: 我一哭，爸爸就给我放音乐。

lines.en: Then I was quiet and smiled at him.
lines.zh: 然后我就安静下来，对着他笑。

lines.en: My favorite toy was a little red ball.
lines.zh: 我最喜欢的玩具是一个红色的小球。

lines.en: Now I am older and taller.
lines.zh: 现在我长大了，也长高了。

lines.en: I can walk, run, talk and swim.
lines.zh: 我会走，会跑，会说话，还会游泳。

lines.en: But I still love my mother and father very much.
lines.zh: 但是我仍然非常爱我的爸爸妈妈。

lines.en: What were you like when you were small?
lines.zh: 你小时候是什么样的？

patterns.en: When you were small, could you walk? No, I could not.
patterns.zh: 你小时候会走路吗？不，我不会。

patterns.en: When you were small, could you talk? No, I could not.
patterns.zh: 你小时候会说话吗？不，我不会。

patterns.en: When you were small, could you swim? No, I could not.
patterns.zh: 你小时候会游泳吗？不，我不会。

patterns.en: When you were small, could you cry? Yes, I could.
patterns.zh: 你小时候会哭吗？是的，我会。

patterns.en: When you were small, could you smile? Yes, I could.
patterns.zh: 你小时候会笑吗？是的，我会。

lines.en: This is my classroom, and it is big and bright.
lines.zh: 这是我的教室，它又大又明亮。

lines.en: When you come in, you can see a big board.
lines.zh: 一进门，你就能看到一块大黑板。

lines.en: Our teacher writes on it every day.
lines.zh: 老师每天都在上面写字。

lines.en: Over the board, there is a clock.
lines.zh: 黑板上方有一个钟。

lines.en: There are thirty desks and chairs in the room.
lines.zh: 教室里有三十套课桌椅。

lines.en: My desk is near the window.
lines.zh: 我的课桌在窗户旁边。

lines.en: From my seat, I can see trees and birds.
lines.zh: 坐在座位上，我能看到树和小鸟。

lines.en: So I like my seat very much.
lines.zh: 所以我非常喜欢我的座位。

lines.en: I like my classroom, too.
lines.zh: 我也喜欢我的教室。

lines.en: What is in your classroom?
lines.zh: 你的教室里有什么？

patterns.en: Is there a clock in your classroom? Yes, there is.
patterns.zh: 你的教室里有钟吗？是的，有。

patterns.en: Is there a computer in your classroom? Yes, there is.
patterns.zh: 你的教室里有电脑吗？是的，有。

patterns.en: Is there a TV in your classroom? No, there isn't.
patterns.zh: 你的教室里有电视吗？不，没有。

patterns.en: Are there maps in your classroom? Yes, there are.
patterns.zh: 你的教室里有地图吗？是的，有。

patterns.en: Are there flowers in your classroom? Yes, there are.
patterns.zh: 你的教室里有花吗？是的，有。

lines.en: I have a best friend at school.
lines.zh: 我在学校有一个最好的朋友。

lines.en: She is in my class, and we sit together.
lines.zh: 她和我同班，我们还是同桌。

lines.en: She has long black hair and a big smile.
lines.zh: 她留着长长的黑头发，总是笑得很灿烂。

lines.en: She is kind and funny.
lines.zh: 她又善良又有趣。

lines.en: She can draw well, but math is hard for her.
lines.zh: 她画画很好，但是数学对她来说很难。

lines.en: So I help her with math.
lines.zh: 所以我帮她学数学。

lines.en: And she helps me with my pictures.
lines.zh: 她也帮我画画。

lines.en: After school, we play together.
lines.zh: 放学后，我们一起玩。

lines.en: We are always happy when we are together.
lines.zh: 我们在一起的时候总是很开心。

lines.en: Who is your best friend?
lines.zh: 你最好的朋友是谁？

patterns.en: What is your friend like? She is kind.
patterns.zh: 你的朋友是什么样的？她很善良。

patterns.en: What is your friend like? He is funny.
patterns.zh: 你的朋友是什么样的？他很有趣。

patterns.en: What is your friend like? She is clever.
patterns.zh: 你的朋友是什么样的？她很聪明。

patterns.en: What is your friend like? He is quiet.
patterns.zh: 你的朋友是什么样的？他很安静。

patterns.en: What is your friend like? She is friendly.
patterns.zh: 你的朋友是什么样的？她很友好。

lines.en: The bell rings, and it is break time.
lines.zh: 铃声响了，课间休息开始了。

lines.en: We all run out to the playground.
lines.zh: 我们都跑到操场上。

lines.en: Some boys are playing football there.
lines.zh: 一些男孩在那里踢足球。

lines.en: Some girls are jumping and laughing near them.
lines.zh: 一些女孩在他们旁边跳啊，笑啊。

lines.en: My friend and I are sitting under a tree.
lines.zh: 我和朋友坐在树下。

lines.en: We are eating apples and talking about our class.
lines.zh: 我们一边吃苹果，一边聊着课上的事。

lines.en: The sun is warm on our faces.
lines.zh: 阳光暖暖地照在我们脸上。

lines.en: Then I can hear the bell again.
lines.zh: 这时，我又听到了铃声。

lines.en: Break time is short, but it is fun.
lines.zh: 课间很短，但是很好玩。

lines.en: What do you do at break time?
lines.zh: 你课间做什么？

patterns.en: Are you playing football? Yes, I am.
patterns.zh: 你在踢足球吗？是的，我在踢。

patterns.en: Are you eating an apple? Yes, I am.
patterns.zh: 你在吃苹果吗？是的，我在吃。

patterns.en: Are you talking with your friend? Yes, I am.
patterns.zh: 你在和朋友聊天吗？是的，我在聊。

patterns.en: Are you reading a book? No, I'm not.
patterns.zh: 你在看书吗？不，我没有。

patterns.en: Are you drawing a picture? No, I'm not.
patterns.zh: 你在画画吗？不，我没有。

lines.en: I have a pen friend, and his name is Tom.
lines.zh: 我有一个笔友，他叫汤姆。

lines.en: He is from London.
lines.zh: 他来自伦敦。

lines.en: He is as old as me.
lines.zh: 他和我一样大。

lines.en: He goes to a school near the sea.
lines.zh: 他在海边的一所学校上学。

lines.en: He likes football and music.
lines.zh: 他喜欢足球和音乐。

lines.en: He wants to know about my school.
lines.zh: 他想了解我的学校。

lines.en: So now I am writing a letter to him.
lines.zh: 所以现在我正在给他写信。

lines.en: I am putting a picture of my class in it.
lines.zh: 我在信里放了一张我们班的照片。

lines.en: I hope he will be happy to get my letter.
lines.zh: 我希望他收到我的信会很开心。

lines.en: Do you have a pen friend?
lines.zh: 你有笔友吗？

patterns.en: What does your pen friend like? He likes music.
patterns.zh: 你的笔友喜欢什么？他喜欢音乐。

patterns.en: What does your pen friend like? He likes football.
patterns.zh: 你的笔友喜欢什么？他喜欢足球。

patterns.en: What does your pen friend like? He likes reading.
patterns.zh: 你的笔友喜欢什么？他喜欢读书。

patterns.en: What does your pen friend like? He likes animals.
patterns.zh: 你的笔友喜欢什么？他喜欢动物。

patterns.en: What does your pen friend like? She likes painting.
patterns.zh: 你的笔友喜欢什么？她喜欢画画。

lines.en: I remember my first day at school.
lines.zh: 我还记得我上学的第一天。

lines.en: I was six years old.
lines.zh: 那时我六岁。

lines.en: My mom took me to school.
lines.zh: 妈妈送我去学校。

lines.en: The school was very big.
lines.zh: 学校很大很大。

lines.en: At first, I was shy and a little afraid.
lines.zh: 一开始，我有点害羞，还有点害怕。

lines.en: But my teacher was kind to me.
lines.zh: 但是老师对我很好。

lines.en: She gave me a new book and a pencil.
lines.zh: 她给了我一本新书和一支铅笔。

lines.en: Then I met a new friend in my class.
lines.zh: 后来，我在班上认识了一个新朋友。

lines.en: We played together, and I was happy at last.
lines.zh: 我们一起玩，我终于开心起来了。

lines.en: How did you feel on your first day?
lines.zh: 你上学第一天感觉怎么样？

patterns.en: How did you feel on your first day? I was happy.
patterns.zh: 你第一天感觉怎么样？我很开心。

patterns.en: How did you feel on your first day? I was shy.
patterns.zh: 你第一天感觉怎么样？我很害羞。

patterns.en: How did you feel on your first day? I was afraid.
patterns.zh: 你第一天感觉怎么样？我很害怕。

patterns.en: How did you feel on your first day? I was excited.
patterns.zh: 你第一天感觉怎么样？我很兴奋。

patterns.en: How did you feel on your first day? I was tired.
patterns.zh: 你第一天感觉怎么样？我很累。

lines.en: Every morning, I have breakfast with my family.
lines.zh: 我每天早上和家人一起吃早饭。

lines.en: My mom gets up early to make it.
lines.zh: 妈妈很早就起床做早饭。

lines.en: First, I have a glass of warm milk.
lines.zh: 我先喝一杯热牛奶。

lines.en: Then I have an egg and some bread.
lines.zh: 然后吃一个鸡蛋和一些面包。

lines.en: Sometimes there is rice soup, too.
lines.zh: 有时候还有米粥。

lines.en: My dad likes noodles for breakfast.
lines.zh: 爸爸早饭喜欢吃面条。

lines.en: After breakfast, I am full and strong.
lines.zh: 吃完早饭，我饱饱的，很有力气。

lines.en: So I can run and play at school.
lines.zh: 所以在学校我能跑能玩。

lines.en: Breakfast is an important meal of the day.
lines.zh: 早饭是一天中很重要的一顿饭。

lines.en: What do you have for breakfast?
lines.zh: 你早饭吃什么？

patterns.en: What do you have for breakfast? I have milk and bread.
patterns.zh: 你早饭吃什么？我喝牛奶，吃面包。

patterns.en: What do you have for breakfast? I have eggs and rice soup.
patterns.zh: 你早饭吃什么？我吃鸡蛋，喝米粥。

patterns.en: What do you have for breakfast? I have noodles.
patterns.zh: 你早饭吃什么？我吃面条。

patterns.en: What do you have for breakfast? I have a banana and juice.
patterns.zh: 你早饭吃什么？我吃香蕉，喝果汁。

patterns.en: What do you have for breakfast? I have dumplings.
patterns.zh: 你早饭吃什么？我吃饺子。

lines.en: I like healthy food, because it makes me strong.
lines.zh: 我喜欢健康的食物，因为它让我变强壮。

lines.en: Every morning, I have an apple and some milk.
lines.zh: 每天早上，我吃一个苹果，喝一些牛奶。

lines.en: Milk is good for my bones.
lines.zh: 牛奶对我的骨头有好处。

lines.en: At lunch, I have fish, rice and green vegetables.
lines.zh: 午饭我吃鱼、米饭和绿色蔬菜。

lines.en: My mother cooks them for me.
lines.zh: 这些都是妈妈给我做的。

lines.en: I like cake, too, because it is sweet.
lines.zh: 我也喜欢蛋糕，因为它很甜。

lines.en: But sugar is bad for my teeth.
lines.zh: 但是糖对我的牙齿不好。

lines.en: So I have cake only on my birthday.
lines.zh: 所以我只在过生日时吃蛋糕。

lines.en: Now I am strong and healthy.
lines.zh: 现在我又强壮又健康。

lines.en: Do you like healthy food?
lines.zh: 你喜欢健康的食物吗？

patterns.en: Is milk good for you? Yes, it is.
patterns.zh: 牛奶对你有好处吗？是的，有好处。

patterns.en: Is fruit good for you? Yes, it is.
patterns.zh: 水果对你有好处吗？是的，有好处。

patterns.en: Is fish good for you? Yes, it is.
patterns.zh: 鱼对你有好处吗？是的，有好处。

patterns.en: Is sugar good for you? No, it isn't.
patterns.zh: 糖对你有好处吗？不，没有好处。

patterns.en: Are vegetables good for you? Yes, they are.
patterns.zh: 蔬菜对你有好处吗？是的，有好处。

lines.en: It is lunch time at school.
lines.zh: 现在是学校的午饭时间。

lines.en: We are all sitting at long tables.
lines.zh: 我们都坐在长长的桌子旁。

lines.en: The cooks are giving us our food.
lines.zh: 厨师们在给我们打饭。

lines.en: Today there is rice, chicken and green vegetables.
lines.zh: 今天有米饭、鸡肉和绿色蔬菜。

lines.en: There is tomato soup, too.
lines.zh: 还有西红柿汤。

lines.en: My friend is putting her carrots on my plate.
lines.zh: 我的朋友正把她的胡萝卜放到我的盘子里。

lines.en: But I like them, so I am eating them all.
lines.zh: 不过我喜欢吃，所以我把它们全吃了。

lines.en: Our teacher is eating with us.
lines.zh: 老师在和我们一起吃饭。

lines.en: She says good food helps us grow.
lines.zh: 她说好的食物能帮助我们长大。

lines.en: What do you have for lunch at school?
lines.zh: 你在学校午饭吃什么？

patterns.en: What are you eating? I'm eating rice.
patterns.zh: 你在吃什么？我在吃米饭。

patterns.en: What are you eating? I'm eating chicken.
patterns.zh: 你在吃什么？我在吃鸡肉。

patterns.en: What are you eating? I'm eating noodles.
patterns.zh: 你在吃什么？我在吃面条。

patterns.en: What are you eating? I'm eating some fish.
patterns.zh: 你在吃什么？我在吃鱼。

patterns.en: What are you eating? I'm eating a tomato.
patterns.zh: 你在吃什么？我在吃西红柿。

lines.en: Dad is cooking dinner, and I am helping him.
lines.zh: 爸爸在做晚饭，我在给他帮忙。

lines.en: First, he is cutting the potatoes.
lines.zh: 他先在切土豆。

lines.en: At the same time, I am washing the rice.
lines.zh: 与此同时，我在洗米。

lines.en: Then he puts the potatoes in the soup.
lines.zh: 然后他把土豆放进汤里。

lines.en: The soup is cooking on the fire.
lines.zh: 汤在火上咕嘟咕嘟地煮着。

lines.en: Dad is putting some salt in it.
lines.zh: 爸爸在往汤里放一些盐。

lines.en: Now the soup smells very good.
lines.zh: 现在汤闻起来好香。

lines.en: At last, it is ready!
lines.zh: 终于做好了！

lines.en: I love cooking with Dad.
lines.zh: 我喜欢和爸爸一起做饭。

lines.en: Do you cook with your family?
lines.zh: 你和家人一起做饭吗？

patterns.en: What are you doing? I'm washing the rice.
patterns.zh: 你在做什么？我在洗米。

patterns.en: What are you doing? I'm cutting the potatoes.
patterns.zh: 你在做什么？我在切土豆。

patterns.en: What are you doing? I'm cleaning the plates.
patterns.zh: 你在做什么？我在洗盘子。

patterns.en: What is Dad doing? He's cooking the soup.
patterns.zh: 爸爸在做什么？他在煮汤。

patterns.en: What is your mother doing? She's making a cake.
patterns.zh: 你妈妈在做什么？她在做蛋糕。

lines.en: Last Saturday, we had a picnic.
lines.zh: 上个星期六，我们去野餐了。

lines.en: We went to the park by the lake.
lines.zh: 我们去了湖边的公园。

lines.en: My mom made sandwiches for us.
lines.zh: 妈妈给我们做了三明治。

lines.en: My dad had a bag of fruit and juice.
lines.zh: 爸爸带了一袋水果和果汁。

lines.en: Then we sat on the grass under a tree.
lines.zh: 然后我们坐在树下的草地上。

lines.en: The sandwiches were very delicious.
lines.zh: 三明治非常好吃。

lines.en: After that, I ate a big red apple.
lines.zh: 吃完三明治，我又吃了一个大红苹果。

lines.en: After lunch, we played a ball game.
lines.zh: 午饭后，我们一起玩球。

lines.en: It was a really happy day.
lines.zh: 那真是快乐的一天。

lines.en: Do you like picnics?
lines.zh: 你喜欢野餐吗？

patterns.en: What did you eat at the picnic? I ate sandwiches.
patterns.zh: 野餐时你吃了什么？我吃了三明治。

patterns.en: What did you eat at the picnic? I ate bananas.
patterns.zh: 野餐时你吃了什么？我吃了香蕉。

patterns.en: What did you eat at the picnic? I ate some cake.
patterns.zh: 野餐时你吃了什么？我吃了一些蛋糕。

patterns.en: What did you eat at the picnic? I ate chicken.
patterns.zh: 野餐时你吃了什么？我吃了鸡肉。

patterns.en: What did you eat at the picnic? I ate grapes.
patterns.zh: 野餐时你吃了什么？我吃了葡萄。

lines.en: I have a pet cat, white and soft.
lines.zh: 我有一只宠物猫，她白白的，软软的。

lines.en: She has green eyes and a long tail.
lines.zh: 她有绿色的眼睛和长长的尾巴。

lines.en: Every morning, she comes to my bed.
lines.zh: 每天早上，她都会跑到我的床边。

lines.en: Then I get up and feed her.
lines.zh: 然后我起床喂她。

lines.en: She likes fish and milk very much.
lines.zh: 她非常喜欢吃鱼，喝牛奶。

lines.en: After breakfast, she plays in the garden.
lines.zh: 吃完早饭，她就去花园里玩。

lines.en: She can jump very high and climb trees.
lines.zh: 她能跳得很高，还会爬树。

lines.en: At night, she sleeps on my bed again.
lines.zh: 晚上，她又回到我的床上睡觉。

lines.en: She is my good friend.
lines.zh: 她是我的好朋友。

lines.en: Do you have a pet?
lines.zh: 你有宠物吗？

patterns.en: Do you have a pet? Yes, I have a cat.
patterns.zh: 你有宠物吗？是的，我有一只猫。

patterns.en: Do you have a pet? Yes, I have a dog.
patterns.zh: 你有宠物吗？是的，我有一只狗。

patterns.en: Do you have a pet? Yes, I have a rabbit.
patterns.zh: 你有宠物吗？是的，我有一只兔子。

patterns.en: Do you have a pet? Yes, I have some fish.
patterns.zh: 你有宠物吗？是的，我有几条鱼。

patterns.en: Do you have a pet? No, I don't.
patterns.zh: 你有宠物吗？不，我没有。

lines.en: Today, my class is at the zoo.
lines.zh: 今天，我们班在动物园。

lines.en: There are many animals here.
lines.zh: 这里有很多动物。

lines.en: First, we see a big elephant.
lines.zh: 我们先看到了一头大象。

lines.en: It has a long nose and big ears.
lines.zh: 它有长长的鼻子和大大的耳朵。

lines.en: Next to it, there is a tall giraffe.
lines.zh: 它旁边有一只高高的长颈鹿。

lines.en: Then we see some monkeys in the trees.
lines.zh: 然后我们看到树上有一些猴子。

lines.en: They are jumping and climbing, and we laugh.
lines.zh: 它们跳来跳去，爬上爬下，逗得我们哈哈大笑。

lines.en: At last, we see the pandas.
lines.zh: 最后，我们看到了熊猫。

lines.en: They are fat and cute, and they are my favorite.
lines.zh: 它们胖胖的，很可爱，是我最喜欢的动物。

lines.en: What animals do you like?
lines.zh: 你喜欢什么动物？

patterns.en: What can a monkey do? It can climb.
patterns.zh: 猴子会做什么？它会爬树。

patterns.en: What can a bird do? It can fly.
patterns.zh: 小鸟会做什么？它会飞。

patterns.en: What can a fish do? It can swim.
patterns.zh: 鱼会做什么？它会游泳。

patterns.en: What can a rabbit do? It can jump.
patterns.zh: 兔子会做什么？它会跳。

patterns.en: What can a dog do? It can run fast.
patterns.zh: 小狗会做什么？它会跑得很快。

lines.en: It is a sunny morning in the garden.
lines.zh: 花园里，这是一个晴朗的早晨。

lines.en: Grandpa and I are working here together.
lines.zh: 我和爷爷正在这里一起干活。

lines.en: He is giving water to the plants.
lines.zh: 他在给植物浇水。

lines.en: And I am planting some seeds in the earth.
lines.zh: 我在土里种一些种子。

lines.en: The flowers are red, pink and yellow.
lines.zh: 花儿有红的、粉的，还有黄的。

lines.en: Bees are flying from flower to flower.
lines.zh: 蜜蜂在花丛间飞来飞去。

lines.en: Then I hear a sound in the grass.
lines.zh: 这时，我听到草丛里有声音。

lines.en: Look! It is a little frog, and it is jumping.
lines.zh: 看！是一只小青蛙，它正在跳呢。

lines.en: We smile, because the garden is full of life.
lines.zh: 我们笑了，因为花园里充满了生机。

lines.en: What can you see in your garden?
lines.zh: 你的花园里能看到什么？

patterns.en: What is the bird doing? It's singing.
patterns.zh: 小鸟在做什么？它在唱歌。

patterns.en: What is the bee doing? It's flying.
patterns.zh: 蜜蜂在做什么？它在飞。

patterns.en: What is the frog doing? It's jumping.
patterns.zh: 青蛙在做什么？它在跳。

patterns.en: What is the cat doing? It's sleeping.
patterns.zh: 猫在做什么？它在睡觉。

patterns.en: What is the dog doing? It's running.
patterns.zh: 小狗在做什么？它在跑。

lines.en: Last Sunday, we went to the forest.
lines.zh: 上个星期天，我们去了森林。

lines.en: The trees were very tall and green.
lines.zh: 树又高又绿。

lines.en: The air was fresh and cool.
lines.zh: 空气清新又凉爽。

lines.en: We walked by a little river.
lines.zh: 我们沿着一条小河散步。

lines.en: Then I saw a little rabbit under a tree.
lines.zh: 这时，我看到树下有一只小兔子。

lines.en: It looked at me and jumped away.
lines.zh: 它看了看我，就跳走了。

lines.en: My brother picked up some nuts for the rabbit.
lines.zh: 弟弟捡了一些坚果，想留给小兔子。

lines.en: After that, we listened to the birds in the trees.
lines.zh: 后来，我们听着树上的鸟叫。

lines.en: It was a quiet and happy day.
lines.zh: 那是安静又快乐的一天。

lines.en: Have you been to a forest?
lines.zh: 你去过森林吗？

patterns.en: What did you see in the forest? I saw a rabbit.
patterns.zh: 你在森林里看到了什么？我看到了一只兔子。

patterns.en: What did you see in the forest? I saw some birds.
patterns.zh: 你在森林里看到了什么？我看到了一些小鸟。

patterns.en: What did you see in the forest? I saw a frog.
patterns.zh: 你在森林里看到了什么？我看到了一只青蛙。

patterns.en: What did you see in the forest? I saw tall trees.
patterns.zh: 你在森林里看到了什么？我看到了高高的树。

patterns.en: What did you see in the forest? I saw a little river.
patterns.zh: 你在森林里看到了什么？我看到了一条小河。

lines.en: Last week, we went to a farm.
lines.zh: 上个星期，我们去了一个农场。

lines.en: There were cows, pigs and sheep.
lines.zh: 那里有奶牛、猪和羊。

lines.en: First, I gave some grass to a cow.
lines.zh: 我先给一头奶牛喂了些草。

lines.en: Next, I saw the little pigs.
lines.zh: 接着，我看到了小猪。

lines.en: They were very dirty!
lines.zh: 它们脏兮兮的！

lines.en: After that, we took apples from the trees.
lines.zh: 后来，我们从树上摘了苹果。

lines.en: The apples were red and sweet.
lines.zh: 苹果又红又甜。

lines.en: At last, the farmer put me on his horse.
lines.zh: 最后，农场主把我抱上了他的马。

lines.en: It was a great day on the farm!
lines.zh: 那是在农场度过的很棒的一天！

lines.en: Have you been to a farm?
lines.zh: 你去过农场吗？

patterns.en: What did you see on the farm? I saw some cows.
patterns.zh: 你在农场看到了什么？我看到了一些奶牛。

patterns.en: What did you see on the farm? I saw some pigs.
patterns.zh: 你在农场看到了什么？我看到了一些猪。

patterns.en: What did you see on the farm? I saw some sheep.
patterns.zh: 你在农场看到了什么？我看到了一些羊。

patterns.en: What did you see on the farm? I saw some goats.
patterns.zh: 你在农场看到了什么？我看到了一些山羊。

patterns.en: What did you see on the farm? I saw a horse.
patterns.zh: 你在农场看到了什么？我看到了一匹马。

lines.en: Spring is here, and the weather is warm.
lines.zh: 春天来了，天气变暖和了。

lines.en: The trees are green again.
lines.zh: 树又绿了。

lines.en: There are flowers in every garden.
lines.zh: 每个花园里都开满了花。

lines.en: In the morning, birds sing in the trees.
lines.zh: 早上，小鸟在树上唱歌。

lines.en: So I get up early to listen.
lines.zh: 所以我早早起床听它们唱歌。

lines.en: After school, I go to the park with my friends.
lines.zh: 放学后，我和朋友们去公园。

lines.en: The grass is soft, so we sit on it.
lines.zh: 草地软软的，我们就坐在上面。

lines.en: Then we fly kites in the warm wind.
lines.zh: 然后我们在暖暖的风里放风筝。

lines.en: I like spring, because it is warm and green.
lines.zh: 我喜欢春天，因为它温暖又绿意盎然。

lines.en: Which season do you like?
lines.zh: 你喜欢哪个季节？

patterns.en: Which season do you like? I like spring.
patterns.zh: 你喜欢哪个季节？我喜欢春天。

patterns.en: Which season do you like? I like summer.
patterns.zh: 你喜欢哪个季节？我喜欢夏天。

patterns.en: Which season do you like? I like autumn.
patterns.zh: 你喜欢哪个季节？我喜欢秋天。

patterns.en: Which season do you like? I like winter.
patterns.zh: 你喜欢哪个季节？我喜欢冬天。

lines.en: It is a hot summer day.
lines.zh: 今天是炎热的夏日。

lines.en: The sun is big and bright in the sky.
lines.zh: 太阳又大又亮地挂在天上。

lines.en: It is too hot to play outside.
lines.zh: 外面太热了，没法出去玩。

lines.en: So I stay at home and read a book.
lines.zh: 所以我待在家里看书。

lines.en: Then my mom gives me some cold watermelon.
lines.zh: 然后妈妈给我拿来了冰西瓜。

lines.en: It is sweet, and it makes me cool.
lines.zh: 西瓜甜甜的，吃完我就凉快了。

lines.en: In the evening, the air is not so hot.
lines.zh: 到了傍晚，天气没那么热了。

lines.en: So we can go swimming in the lake.
lines.zh: 所以我们可以去湖里游泳。

lines.en: Summer is hot, but I love it.
lines.zh: 夏天很热，但是我喜欢它。

lines.en: What can you do on a hot day?
lines.zh: 热天你能做什么？

patterns.en: What can you do in summer? I can swim.
patterns.zh: 夏天你能做什么？我能游泳。

patterns.en: What can you do in spring? I can fly a kite.
patterns.zh: 春天你能做什么？我能放风筝。

patterns.en: What can you do in autumn? I can pick apples.
patterns.zh: 秋天你能做什么？我能摘苹果。

patterns.en: What can you do in winter? I can play in the snow.
patterns.zh: 冬天你能做什么？我能在雪里玩。

lines.en: It is raining this morning.
lines.zh: 今天早上在下雨。

lines.en: The sky is dark and grey.
lines.zh: 天空又暗又灰。

lines.en: I put on my red boots and take my umbrella.
lines.zh: 我穿上红靴子，带上雨伞。

lines.en: Then I go out with my mom.
lines.zh: 然后我和妈妈出门了。

lines.en: There is water all over the road.
lines.zh: 路上到处都是水。

lines.en: I am jumping in the water, and Mom is laughing.
lines.zh: 我在水里跳来跳去，妈妈在一旁笑。

lines.en: A little dog is running in the rain, too.
lines.zh: 一只小狗也在雨里跑。

lines.en: Now my socks are wet, but I am happy.
lines.zh: 现在我的袜子湿了，但是我很开心。

lines.en: I like the rain!
lines.zh: 我喜欢下雨！

lines.en: Do you like the rain?
lines.zh: 你喜欢下雨吗？

patterns.en: What is the weather like? It's raining.
patterns.zh: 天气怎么样？在下雨。

patterns.en: What is the weather like? It's snowing.
patterns.zh: 天气怎么样？在下雪。

patterns.en: What is the weather like? It's cold and wet.
patterns.zh: 天气怎么样？又冷又湿。

patterns.en: What is the weather like? It's warm.
patterns.zh: 天气怎么样？很暖和。

lines.en: It is snowing today, and everything is white.
lines.zh: 今天下雪了，到处都白白的。

lines.en: My friends and I are playing in the snow.
lines.zh: 我和朋友们在雪里玩。

lines.en: We are making a snowman in the garden.
lines.zh: 我们在花园里堆雪人。

lines.en: First, we make his body and head.
lines.zh: 我们先堆出他的身体和头。

lines.en: Then we give him a carrot nose.
lines.zh: 然后给他安上一个胡萝卜鼻子。

lines.en: My little dog is jumping round him.
lines.zh: 我的小狗围着他跳来跳去。

lines.en: My hands are cold, but we are having fun.
lines.zh: 我的手很冷，但是我们玩得很开心。

lines.en: Now Mom is calling us in for hot milk.
lines.zh: 现在妈妈在叫我们进屋喝热牛奶。

lines.en: Goodbye, snowman, see you tomorrow!
lines.zh: 再见，雪人，明天见！

lines.en: Do you like playing in the snow?
lines.zh: 你喜欢在雪里玩吗？

patterns.en: What are you doing? I'm playing in the snow.
patterns.zh: 你在做什么？我在雪里玩。

patterns.en: What are you doing? I'm making a snowman.
patterns.zh: 你在做什么？我在堆雪人。

patterns.en: What are you doing? I'm running in the snow.
patterns.zh: 你在做什么？我在雪里跑。

patterns.en: What are you doing? I'm wearing my warm coat.
patterns.zh: 你在做什么？我在穿我的暖和外套。

patterns.en: What are you doing? I'm drinking hot milk.
patterns.zh: 你在做什么？我在喝热牛奶。

lines.en: Yesterday was a windy autumn day.
lines.zh: 昨天是一个刮风的秋日。

lines.en: The trees were yellow and red.
lines.zh: 树变得黄黄红红的。

lines.en: It was a good day for a kite.
lines.zh: 那是放风筝的好日子。

lines.en: So I went to the park with my dad.
lines.zh: 所以我和爸爸去了公园。

lines.en: Our kite went up in the strong wind.
lines.zh: 我们的风筝在大风里飞了起来。

lines.en: Soon it was very high in the sky.
lines.zh: 很快它就飞得高高的。

lines.en: Then the wind took my hat!
lines.zh: 这时，风把我的帽子吹走了！

lines.en: We laughed and looked for it.
lines.zh: 我们笑着去找帽子。

lines.en: At last, we saw it in a tree.
lines.zh: 最后，我们在一棵树上找到了它。

lines.en: Do you like windy days?
lines.zh: 你喜欢刮风的日子吗？

patterns.en: What was the weather like yesterday? It was windy.
patterns.zh: 昨天天气怎么样？刮风了。

patterns.en: What was the weather like yesterday? It was sunny.
patterns.zh: 昨天天气怎么样？阳光明媚。

patterns.en: What was the weather like yesterday? It was rainy.
patterns.zh: 昨天天气怎么样？下雨了。

patterns.en: What was the weather like yesterday? It was snowy.
patterns.zh: 昨天天气怎么样？下雪了。

patterns.en: What was the weather like yesterday? It was cloudy.
patterns.zh: 昨天天气怎么样？多云。

lines.en: I can swim, and I love the water.
lines.zh: 我会游泳，我爱玩水。

lines.en: Every summer, I swim in the sea with my father.
lines.zh: 每年夏天，我都和爸爸在海里游泳。

lines.en: The water is warm and blue.
lines.zh: 海水又暖和又蓝。

lines.en: First, I kick my legs.
lines.zh: 我先踢腿。

lines.en: Then I move my arms.
lines.zh: 然后划动手臂。

lines.en: Now I can swim very well.
lines.zh: 现在我游得很好。

lines.en: My little sister can't swim.
lines.zh: 我的妹妹还不会游泳。

lines.en: But she can jump and play in the sand.
lines.zh: 但是她会在沙滩上跳跳玩玩。

lines.en: Next summer, I will help her.
lines.zh: 明年夏天，我要帮她学游泳。

lines.en: Can you swim?
lines.zh: 你会游泳吗？

patterns.en: Can you swim? Yes, I can.
patterns.zh: 你会游泳吗？是的，我会。

patterns.en: Can you jump? Yes, I can.
patterns.zh: 你会跳吗？是的，我会。

patterns.en: Can you kick a ball? Yes, I can.
patterns.zh: 你会踢球吗？是的，我会。

patterns.en: Can you cook? No, I can't.
patterns.zh: 你会做饭吗？不，我不会。

patterns.en: Can you fly? No, I can't.
patterns.zh: 你会飞吗？不，我不会。

lines.en: My hobby is painting.
lines.zh: 我的爱好是画画。

lines.en: I paint after school every day.
lines.zh: 我每天放学后画画。

lines.en: I have a box of paints and some brushes.
lines.zh: 我有一盒颜料和几支画笔。

lines.en: Look, I am painting a picture now.
lines.zh: 看，我现在正在画一幅画。

lines.en: There is a tall tree in my picture.
lines.zh: 我的画里有一棵高高的树。

lines.en: There are some birds on its branches.
lines.zh: 树枝上有几只小鸟。

lines.en: Over the tree, I am painting a blue sky.
lines.zh: 在树的上方，我正在画蓝蓝的天空。

lines.en: Painting makes me quiet and happy.
lines.zh: 画画让我又安静又快乐。

lines.en: So I hope to be a painter some day.
lines.zh: 所以我希望有一天能成为画家。

lines.en: What is your hobby?
lines.zh: 你的爱好是什么？

patterns.en: What is your hobby? I like painting.
patterns.zh: 你的爱好是什么？我喜欢画画。

patterns.en: What is your hobby? I like reading.
patterns.zh: 你的爱好是什么？我喜欢读书。

patterns.en: What is your hobby? I like singing.
patterns.zh: 你的爱好是什么？我喜欢唱歌。

patterns.en: What is your hobby? I like cooking.
patterns.zh: 你的爱好是什么？我喜欢做饭。

patterns.en: What is your hobby? I like swimming.
patterns.zh: 你的爱好是什么？我喜欢游泳。

lines.en: My favorite sport is running.
lines.zh: 我最喜欢的运动是跑步。

lines.en: After school, I run with my friends.
lines.zh: 放学后，我和朋友们一起跑步。

lines.en: We run round the field together.
lines.zh: 我们一起绕着操场跑。

lines.en: Look! My friend is in front of me.
lines.zh: 看！我的朋友跑在我前面。

lines.en: So I am running after him.
lines.zh: 所以我在后面追他。

lines.en: I run quickly, so soon I am next to him.
lines.zh: 我能跑得很快，所以很快就追上了他。

lines.en: At last, we are tired, but we are happy.
lines.zh: 最后，我们都累了，但是很开心。

lines.en: Running makes us strong and healthy.
lines.zh: 跑步让我们又强壮又健康。

lines.zh: 你最喜欢的运动是什么？

patterns.en: What is your favorite sport? I like running.
patterns.zh: 你最喜欢的运动是什么？我喜欢跑步。

patterns.en: What is your favorite sport? I like swimming.
patterns.zh: 你最喜欢的运动是什么？我喜欢游泳。

patterns.en: What is your favorite sport? I like football.
patterns.zh: 你最喜欢的运动是什么？我喜欢足球。

patterns.en: What is your favorite sport? I like basketball.
patterns.zh: 你最喜欢的运动是什么？我喜欢篮球。

lines.en: I am sitting in the park with my paints.
lines.zh: 我带着颜料坐在公园里。

lines.en: There are boys and girls all round me.
lines.zh: 我身边到处都是男孩和女孩。

lines.en: Some boys are kicking a ball.
lines.zh: 一些男孩在踢球。

lines.en: Near them, some girls are flying a kite.
lines.zh: 在他们旁边，一些女孩在放风筝。

lines.en: Under a tree, a baby is sleeping.
lines.zh: 树下，一个小宝宝在睡觉。

lines.en: Next to the baby, an old man is reading.
lines.zh: 宝宝旁边，一位老爷爷在看书。

lines.en: His dog is playing with a stick.
lines.zh: 他的狗在玩一根小树枝。

lines.en: They are all happy in the sun.
lines.zh: 他们在阳光下都很开心。

lines.en: So I am painting a picture of them.
lines.zh: 所以我正在给他们画一幅画。

lines.en: What are you doing now?
lines.zh: 你现在在做什么？

patterns.en: What are they doing? They're kicking a ball.
patterns.zh: 他们在做什么？他们在踢球。

patterns.en: What are they doing? They're flying a kite.
patterns.zh: 他们在做什么？他们在放风筝。

patterns.en: What is he doing? He's reading a book.
patterns.zh: 他在做什么？他在看书。

patterns.en: What is she doing? She's painting a picture.
patterns.zh: 她在做什么？她在画画。

patterns.en: What is the baby doing? The baby is sleeping.
patterns.zh: 宝宝在做什么？宝宝在睡觉。

lines.en: Last Friday was Sports Day at our school.
lines.zh: 上个星期五是我们学校的运动会。

lines.en: The weather was sunny and warm.
lines.zh: 天气晴朗又暖和。

lines.en: There were many races on the playground.
lines.zh: 操场上有很多比赛。

lines.en: I was in the running race.
lines.zh: 我参加了跑步比赛。

lines.en: I tried very hard, and my friends called my name.
lines.zh: 我非常努力，朋友们都在喊我的名字。

lines.en: I was second in the race.
lines.zh: 我在比赛中得了第二名。

lines.en: After that, our class won the team race.
lines.zh: 后来，我们班赢得了团体赛。

lines.en: We were all very proud.
lines.zh: 我们都非常自豪。

lines.en: Do you like Sports Day?
lines.zh: 你喜欢运动会吗？

patterns.en: What did you do on Sports Day? I was in a running race.
patterns.zh: 运动会上你做了什么？我参加了跑步比赛。

patterns.en: What did you do on Sports Day? I played basketball.
patterns.zh: 运动会上你做了什么？我打了篮球。

patterns.en: What did you do on Sports Day? I played football.
patterns.zh: 运动会上你做了什么？我踢了足球。

patterns.en: What did you do on Sports Day? I jumped very high.
patterns.zh: 运动会上你做了什么？我跳得很高。

patterns.en: What did you do on Sports Day? I watched the races.
patterns.zh: 运动会上你做了什么？我看了比赛。

lines.en: This is my bedroom.
lines.zh: 这是我的卧室。

lines.en: It is small, but I like it very much.
lines.zh: 它很小，但是我非常喜欢。

lines.en: My bed is near the window.
lines.zh: 我的床在窗户旁边。

lines.en: So the sun comes in every morning.
lines.zh: 所以每天早上阳光都会照进来。

lines.en: On my bed, there is a soft toy bear.
lines.zh: 我的床上有一只软软的玩具熊。

lines.en: He sleeps with me every night.
lines.zh: 他每天晚上都陪我睡觉。

lines.en: Next to the bed, there is a desk.
lines.zh: 床边有一张书桌。

lines.en: I do my homework there after school.
lines.zh: 放学后，我在那里写作业。

lines.en: My bedroom is my quiet, happy place.
lines.zh: 我的卧室是我安静又快乐的小天地。

lines.en: What is in your bedroom?
lines.zh: 你的卧室里有什么？

patterns.en: Where is the bed? It's near the window.
patterns.zh: 床在哪里？在窗户旁边。

patterns.en: Where is the desk? It's by the door.
patterns.zh: 书桌在哪里？在门边。

patterns.en: Where is the clock? It's on the wall.
patterns.zh: 钟在哪里？在墙上。

patterns.en: Where is the bear? It's on the bed.
patterns.zh: 玩具熊在哪里？在床上。

patterns.en: Where are the books? They're on the shelf.
patterns.zh: 书在哪里？在书架上。

lines.en: There are many ways to travel.
lines.zh: 出行的方式有很多。

lines.en: For short trips, I can walk or ride a bike.
lines.zh: 去近的地方，我可以走路或者骑自行车。

lines.en: For school, I take the bus.
lines.zh: 上学的时候，我坐公交车。

lines.en: My dad goes to work by car.
lines.zh: 爸爸开车去上班。

lines.en: In a big city, people can take the subway.
lines.zh: 在大城市里，人们可以坐地铁。

lines.en: For a long trip, we can take the train.
lines.zh: 出远门的时候，我们可以坐火车。

lines.en: A plane can take us far in a few hours.
lines.zh: 飞机能在几个小时内把我们带到很远的地方。

lines.en: Planes are fast, but I like trains.
lines.zh: 飞机很快，但是我喜欢火车。

lines.en: From a train, I can see fields and rivers.
lines.zh: 坐在火车上，我能看到田野和河流。

lines.en: How do you like to travel?
lines.zh: 你喜欢怎样出行？

patterns.zh: 我们怎么去那里？我们可以坐公交车去。

lines.en: I am on the bus to school.
lines.zh: 我正坐在去学校的公交车上。

lines.en: The bus is full this morning.
lines.zh: 今天早上车上坐满了人。

lines.en: At the next stop, an old woman is getting on.
lines.zh: 到了下一站，一位老奶奶正在上车。

lines.en: She has a heavy bag.
lines.zh: 她提着一个很重的包。

lines.en: So I give her my seat.
lines.zh: 所以我把座位让给了她。

lines.en: She smiles at me, and I am happy.
lines.zh: 她对我笑了笑，我很开心。

lines.en: Then I look out of the window.
lines.zh: 然后我看着窗外。

lines.en: There are shops and trees on the street.
lines.zh: 街上有商店和树。

lines.en: Now the bus is stopping at my school.
lines.zh: 现在公交车正停在我的学校门口。

lines.en: Do you go to school by bus?
lines.zh: 你坐公交车上学吗？

patterns.en: How do you go to school? I go by bus.
patterns.zh: 你怎么去上学？我坐公交车去。

lines.en: Last summer, we went to the beach.
lines.zh: 去年夏天，我们去了海边。

lines.en: We went there by train.
lines.zh: 我们是坐火车去的。

lines.en: The sea was blue and the sand was soft.
lines.zh: 大海蓝蓝的，沙子软软的。

lines.en: First, I played in the water with my dad.
lines.zh: 我先和爸爸在水里玩。

lines.en: Then my sister and I made a house of sand.
lines.zh: 然后我和妹妹用沙子堆了一座房子。

lines.en: At lunch, we ate fish and rice.
lines.zh: 午饭我们吃了鱼和米饭。

lines.en: In the evening, we watched the sun go down.
lines.zh: 傍晚，我们看着太阳落下去。

lines.en: It was red and beautiful.
lines.zh: 它红红的，很美。

lines.en: I was tired but very happy.
lines.zh: 我很累，但是非常开心。

lines.en: Where did you go last summer?
lines.zh: 去年夏天你去了哪里？

patterns.en: Where did you go last summer? I went to the beach.
patterns.zh: 去年夏天你去了哪里？我去了海边。

patterns.en: Where did you go last summer? I went to the mountains.
patterns.zh: 去年夏天你去了哪里？我去了山里。

patterns.en: Where did you go last summer? I went to a farm.
patterns.zh: 去年夏天你去了哪里？我去了农场。

patterns.en: Where did you go last summer? I went to the zoo.
patterns.zh: 去年夏天你去了哪里？我去了动物园。

patterns.en: Where did you go last summer? I went to see my grandma.
patterns.zh: 去年夏天你去了哪里？我去看望了奶奶。

lines.en: My first plane trip was last winter.
lines.zh: 我第一次坐飞机是在去年冬天。

lines.en: We went to see my aunt in the south.
lines.zh: 我们去南方看望阿姨。

lines.en: The plane was big and white.
lines.zh: 飞机又大又白。

lines.en: I had a seat by the window.
lines.zh: 我坐在靠窗的位置。

lines.en: When the plane went up, I was a little afraid.
lines.zh: 飞机起飞的时候，我有点害怕。

lines.en: But then I looked out of the window.
lines.zh: 但是后来我往窗外一看。

lines.en: The clouds were under us, like white cotton.
lines.zh: 云朵就在我们下面，像白白的棉花。

lines.en: After three hours, the plane came down.
lines.zh: 三个小时后，飞机降落了。

lines.en: At last, we were in the warm south.
lines.zh: 我们终于到了温暖的南方。

lines.en: Have you been on a plane?
lines.zh: 你坐过飞机吗？

patterns.en: How did you go there? I went by plane.
patterns.zh: 你是怎么去那里的？我坐飞机去的。

patterns.en: How did you go there? I went by train.
patterns.zh: 你是怎么去那里的？我坐火车去的。

patterns.en: How did you go there? I went by bus.
patterns.zh: 你是怎么去那里的？我坐公交车去的。

patterns.en: How did you go there? I went by car.
patterns.zh: 你是怎么去那里的？我坐汽车去的。

patterns.en: How did you go there? I went by boat.
patterns.zh: 你是怎么去那里的？我坐船去的。

lines.en: There is a park near my house.
lines.zh: 我家附近有一个公园。

lines.en: I go there with my grandpa every morning.
lines.zh: 我每天早上和爷爷去那里。

lines.en: First, we walk under the tall trees.
lines.zh: 我们先在高高的树下散步。

lines.en: The air is clean and sweet.
lines.zh: 空气又清新又香甜。

lines.en: Then we come to a little river.
lines.zh: 然后我们来到一条小河边。

lines.en: There is a bridge over it.
lines.zh: 河上有一座桥。

lines.en: We stand on the bridge and look at the fish.
lines.zh: 我们站在桥上看鱼。

lines.en: After that, we sit on a long seat and rest.
lines.zh: 看完鱼，我们坐在长椅上休息。

lines.en: I love this park.
lines.zh: 我爱这个公园。

lines.en: Is there a park near your house?
lines.zh: 你家附近有公园吗？

patterns.en: Is there a park near your house? Yes, there is.
patterns.zh: 你家附近有公园吗？是的，有。

patterns.en: Is there a school near your house? Yes, there is.
patterns.zh: 你家附近有学校吗？是的，有。

patterns.en: Is there a river near your house? No, there isn't.
patterns.zh: 你家附近有河吗？不，没有。

patterns.en: Are there trees in the park? Yes, there are.
patterns.zh: 公园里有树吗？是的，有。

patterns.en: Are there birds in the park? Yes, there are.
patterns.zh: 公园里有鸟吗？是的，有。

patterns.en: Are there boats on the river? Yes, there are.
patterns.zh: 河上有船吗？是的，有。

lines.en: My house is in a small town by a river.
lines.zh: 我家在河边的一座小城里。

lines.en: Every morning, there are boats on the river.
lines.zh: 每天早上，河上都有船。

lines.en: They take fish to the market.
lines.zh: 它们把鱼运到市场去。

lines.en: The market is by the station.
lines.zh: 市场在车站旁边。

lines.en: My mother goes there for fruit and fish.
lines.zh: 妈妈去那里买水果和鱼。

lines.en: Sometimes I go with her.
lines.zh: 有时候我跟她一起去。

lines.en: On the way, we see my school and the library.
lines.zh: 路上，我们会经过我的学校和图书馆。

lines.en: My town is small, but it is beautiful.
lines.zh: 我的小城很小，但是很美。

lines.en: I love my town.
lines.zh: 我爱我的小城。

lines.en: What is in your town?
lines.zh: 你的城市里有什么？

patterns.en: Is there a library in your town? Yes, there is.
patterns.zh: 你的城市里有图书馆吗？是的，有。

patterns.en: Is there a hospital in your town? Yes, there is.
patterns.zh: 你的城市里有医院吗？是的，有。

patterns.en: Is there a market in your town? Yes, there is.
patterns.zh: 你的城市里有市场吗？是的，有。

patterns.en: Is there a station in your town? Yes, there is.
patterns.zh: 你的城市里有车站吗？是的，有。

patterns.en: Is there a zoo in your town? No, there isn't.
patterns.zh: 你的城市里有动物园吗？不，没有。

lines.en: My mother and I go to the shop.
lines.zh: 我和妈妈去商店。

lines.en: There are apples, eggs and bread in the shop.
lines.zh: 商店里有苹果、鸡蛋和面包。

lines.en: I see some big red apples.
lines.zh: 我看到一些又大又红的苹果。

lines.en: So I ask the man for some apples.
lines.zh: 于是我向店里的叔叔要一些苹果。

lines.en: He puts them in a bag for me.
lines.zh: 他把苹果装进袋子里递给我。

lines.en: Then my mother gives him some money.
lines.zh: 然后妈妈付给他一些钱。

lines.en: The man smiles at us.
lines.zh: 那位叔叔对我们笑了笑。

lines.en: I carry the bag, and we go home.
lines.zh: 我提着袋子，我们一起回家。

lines.en: Tonight, we can have apples after dinner.
lines.zh: 今晚吃完饭，我们就可以吃苹果了。

lines.en: Do you like going to the shop?
lines.zh: 你喜欢去商店吗？

patterns.en: Can I have some apples, please? Yes, here you are.
patterns.zh: 我可以要一些苹果吗？好的，给你。

patterns.en: Can I have some bread, please? Yes, here you are.
patterns.zh: 我可以要一些面包吗？好的，给你。

patterns.en: Can I have some milk, please? Yes, here you are.
patterns.zh: 我可以要一些牛奶吗？好的，给你。

patterns.en: Can I have some eggs, please? Yes, here you are.
patterns.zh: 我可以要一些鸡蛋吗？好的，给你。

patterns.en: Can I have some oranges, please? Yes, here you are.
patterns.zh: 我可以要一些橙子吗？好的，给你。

lines.en: I am ill this morning.
lines.zh: 我今天早上生病了。

lines.en: My head is in pain, and I have a cough.
lines.zh: 我头疼，还咳嗽。

lines.en: So my mother is taking me to the doctor.
lines.zh: 所以妈妈正带我去看医生。

lines.en: The doctor is looking at my throat.
lines.zh: 医生正在检查我的喉咙。

lines.en: Then she says I have a cold.
lines.zh: 然后她说我感冒了。

lines.en: I need to rest and drink warm water.
lines.zh: 我需要休息，多喝温水。

lines.en: Now I am at home in bed.
lines.zh: 现在我在家里躺在床上。

lines.en: My mother is giving me some warm soup.
lines.zh: 妈妈正在给我喂热汤。

lines.en: I hope I will be well tomorrow.

lines.en: Last Saturday, my class went to the museum.
lines.zh: 上个星期六，我们班去了博物馆。

lines.en: It was a big old building in the city.
lines.zh: 那是城里一座又大又古老的建筑。

lines.en: First, we saw the bones of a dinosaur.
lines.zh: 我们先看到了恐龙的骨头。

lines.en: They were very long and very old.
lines.zh: 它们又长又古老。

lines.en: Then we went to a room with old pictures.
lines.zh: 然后我们去了一个放着老照片的房间。

lines.en: The pictures showed our city long ago.
lines.zh: 这些照片展示了很久以前的城市。

lines.en: There were no cars then, only carts and horses.
lines.zh: 那时候没有汽车，只有马车和马。

lines.en: I learned a lot about history that day.
lines.zh: 那天我学到了很多历史知识。

lines.en: The museum was really interesting.
lines.zh: 博物馆真有意思。

lines.en: Have you been to a museum?

patterns.zh: 你在博物馆看到了什么？我看到了漂亮的宝石。

lines.en: People do many different jobs.
lines.zh: 人们做着各种不同的工作。

lines.en: My uncle is a farmer.
lines.zh: 我的叔叔是农民。

lines.en: He grows rice and keeps some cows.
lines.zh: 他种水稻，还养了几头牛。

lines.en: My aunt is a doctor in a hospital.
lines.zh: 我的阿姨是医院里的医生。

lines.en: She helps people when they are ill.
lines.zh: 人们生病时，她帮助他们。

lines.en: Our neighbor is a teacher at my school.
lines.zh: 我们的邻居是我学校的老师。

lines.en: He teaches English to us.
lines.zh: 他教我们英语。

lines.en: Every job is important, because it helps others.
lines.zh: 每一份工作都很重要，因为它能帮助别人。

lines.en: When I grow up, I want a useful job.
lines.zh: 我长大后，也想做一份有用的工作。

lines.en: My mom is a nurse in a big hospital.
lines.zh: 我妈妈是一家大医院的护士。

lines.en: She goes to work very early in the morning.
lines.zh: 她每天一大早就去上班。

lines.en: She wears a white uniform and a white hat.
lines.zh: 她穿着白色的制服，戴着白色的帽子。

lines.en: At the hospital, she looks after ill people.
lines.zh: 在医院里，她照顾生病的人。

lines.en: She gives them water and helps them walk.
lines.zh: 她给病人倒水，扶他们走路。

lines.en: She is always kind and patient.
lines.zh: 她总是又亲切又耐心。

lines.en: Her work is hard, so she is often tired.
lines.zh: 她的工作很辛苦，所以她常常很累。

lines.en: So I make tea for her when she comes home.
lines.zh: 所以她回家时，我会给她泡一杯茶。

lines.en: I am proud of my mom.
lines.zh: 我为我的妈妈感到骄傲。

lines.en: Then he is cooking noodles in a big pot.
lines.zh: 然后他在一口大锅里煮面条。

lines.en: The kitchen is very hot, but he is smiling.
lines.zh: 厨房里很热，但是他一直在笑。

lines.en: Now people are coming in for lunch.
lines.zh: 现在人们进来吃午饭了。

lines.en: He is making noodles for all of them.
lines.zh: 他在为所有的人做面条。

lines.en: Everyone says his noodles are delicious.
lines.zh: 大家都说他做的面条很好吃。

lines.en: I must learn a lot about the body.

lines.en: I will also need to be brave and careful.

lines.en: Then some day I can help ill people, too.

title: A Visit to the Fire Station

lines.en: Last week, our class went to a fire station.
lines.zh: 上个星期，我们班去参观了消防站。

lines.en: Some fire fighters were waiting for us.
lines.zh: 一些消防员在那里等我们。

lines.en: They showed us their big red fire engine.
lines.zh: 他们给我们看了他们的大红消防车。

lines.en: It had a long pipe for water.
lines.zh: 车上有一根长长的水管。

lines.en: Then a fire fighter put his hat on my head.
lines.zh: 然后一位消防员把他的帽子戴在我头上。

lines.en: It was very heavy!
lines.zh: 帽子好重啊！

lines.en: After that, he talked to us about his work.
lines.zh: 接着，他给我们讲了他的工作。

lines.en: His job is hard and full of danger.
lines.zh: 他的工作又辛苦又危险。

lines.en: But fire fighters are brave, and they keep us safe.
lines.zh: 但是消防员很勇敢，他们保护着我们的安全。

lines.en: Would you like to be a fire fighter?
lines.zh: 你想当消防员吗？

patterns.zh: 你在消防站看到了什么？我看到了一口大钟。

lines.en: Today is Children's Day.
lines.zh: 今天是儿童节。

lines.en: There is a big show at our school.
lines.zh: 我们学校有一场大型演出。

lines.en: Our parents are all here to watch it.
lines.zh: 爸爸妈妈们都来看演出了。

lines.en: First, some girls are dancing on the stage.
lines.zh: 首先，一些女孩在舞台上跳舞。

lines.en: Then some boys are singing a song.
lines.zh: 然后，一些男孩在唱歌。

lines.en: Now it is my turn.
lines.zh: 现在轮到我了。

lines.en: I am telling a funny story, and everyone is laughing.
lines.zh: 我在讲一个有趣的故事，大家都笑了。

lines.en: My mom is smiling at me.
lines.zh: 妈妈正对着我微笑。

lines.en: I am so happy today.
lines.zh: 今天我太开心了。

lines.en: Happy Children's Day to you!
lines.zh: 祝你儿童节快乐！

lines.en: Today is Dragon Boat Festival.
lines.zh: 今天是端午节。

lines.en: We are by the river with my family.
lines.zh: 我们一家人来到了河边。

lines.en: There are many people here.
lines.zh: 这里有很多人。

lines.en: Look! The dragon boats are racing on the water.
lines.zh: 看！龙舟正在水上比赛。

lines.en: The people in the boats are pulling hard.
lines.zh: 船上的人们在用力划桨。

lines.en: Now the red boat is in front.
lines.zh: 现在红色的龙舟领先了。

lines.en: Everyone is very excited.
lines.zh: 大家都非常兴奋。

lines.en: After the race, Mom gives me a rice dumpling.
lines.zh: 比赛结束后，妈妈给了我一个粽子。

lines.en: It is sweet and delicious.
lines.zh: 它又甜又好吃。

lines.en: Do you like Dragon Boat Festival?
lines.zh: 你喜欢端午节吗？

lines.en: Tonight is the Mid-Autumn Festival.
lines.zh: 今晚是中秋节。

lines.en: The moon is big and round.
lines.zh: 月亮又大又圆。

lines.en: My family is sitting in the garden.
lines.zh: 我们一家人坐在花园里。

lines.en: We are eating mooncakes and fruit.
lines.zh: 我们在吃月饼和水果。

lines.en: My grandma is telling a story about the moon.
lines.zh: 奶奶在讲一个关于月亮的故事。

lines.en: After the story, my brother looks for the moon rabbit.
lines.zh: 听完故事，弟弟就在月亮上找玉兔。

lines.en: Every house near us has bright lights.
lines.zh: 我们附近的每户人家都亮着灯。

lines.en: The night is quiet and warm.
lines.zh: 夜晚安静又温暖。

lines.en: I am happy because we are together.
lines.zh: 我很开心，因为我们在一起。

lines.en: Can you see the moon tonight?
lines.zh: 今晚你能看到月亮吗？

patterns.zh: 你弟弟在做什么？他在看月亮。

lines.en: Spring Festival is our New Year.
lines.zh: 春节是我们的新年。

lines.en: Last Spring Festival, we went to see my grandma.
lines.zh: 去年春节，我们去看望了奶奶。

lines.en: All my family were there.
lines.zh: 我们全家人都在那里。

lines.en: First, we put red paper on the doors.
lines.zh: 我们先在门上贴了红纸。

lines.en: Then my grandma and mother made dumplings.
lines.zh: 然后奶奶和妈妈包了饺子。

lines.en: At night, we had a great meal together.
lines.zh: 晚上，我们一起吃了一顿丰盛的大餐。

lines.en: After the meal, Grandpa gave me a red packet.
lines.zh: 饭后，爷爷给了我一个红包。

lines.en: Then we watched the fireworks in the sky.
lines.zh: 然后我们看了天空中的烟花。

lines.en: I was very happy that night.
lines.zh: 那天晚上我非常开心。

lines.en: Happy New Year to you!
lines.zh: 祝你新年快乐！

lines.zh: 我最棒的一天是去年的生日。

lines.en: In the afternoon, my friends came to my house.

lines.en: First, we played in the garden and laughed.
lines.zh: 我们先在花园里玩耍、欢笑。

lines.en: Then my mother came out with a beautiful cake.
lines.zh: 然后妈妈端出了一个漂亮的蛋糕。

lines.en: We had the cake and some fruit.
lines.zh: 我们吃了蛋糕和一些水果。

lines.en: After that, my friends gave me some presents.
lines.zh: 后来，朋友们送给我一些礼物。

lines.en: My present from my father was a camera.
lines.zh: 爸爸送给我的礼物是一台照相机。

lines.en: So I took pictures of all my friends.
lines.zh: 于是我给朋友们都拍了照片。

lines.en: At night, I was tired but very happy.
lines.zh: 晚上，我很累，但是非常开心。

lines.en: Today I want to talk about my family.
lines.zh: 今天我想谈谈我的家人。

lines.en: There are five people in my family.
lines.zh: 我家有五口人。

lines.en: My dad is a farmer, and my mom is a teacher.
lines.zh: 我爸爸是农民，妈妈是老师。

lines.en: My grandpa and grandma live with us, too.
lines.zh: 爷爷奶奶也和我们住在一起。

lines.en: Grandpa is older than Dad, but he is very strong.
lines.zh: 爷爷比爸爸年纪大，但他身体很结实。

lines.en: That is because he walks in the park every morning.
lines.zh: 那是因为他每天早上都去公园散步。

lines.en: Grandma is good at cooking, and her dumplings are the best.
lines.zh: 奶奶很会做饭，她包的饺子最好吃。

lines.en: Every weekend, we eat her dumplings and talk about our week.
lines.zh: 每个周末，我们一起吃她包的饺子，聊聊这一周的事。

lines.en: I love my family, because we always help each other.
lines.zh: 我爱我的家人，因为我们总是互相帮助。
