lines.en: Good morning, everyone.
lines.zh: 大家早上好。

lines.en: Do you help your parents at home?
lines.zh: 你在家帮爸爸妈妈做事吗？

lines.en: My parents are very busy every day.
lines.zh: 我的爸爸妈妈每天都很忙。

lines.en: So last year, I decided to help them at home.
lines.zh: 所以去年，我决定在家帮他们做事。

lines.en: First, I learned to make my bed every morning.
lines.zh: 首先，我学会了每天早上整理床铺。

lines.en: Then I started to wash the dishes after dinner.
lines.zh: 然后，我开始在晚饭后洗碗。

lines.en: On weekends, I also clean my room and water the flowers.
lines.zh: 周末，我还打扫自己的房间、给花浇水。

lines.en: At first, all this was hard for me.
lines.zh: 一开始，这些事对我来说都很难。

lines.en: But now I can do it quickly and well.
lines.zh: 但现在我能做得又快又好。

lines.en: My parents are happy, and they have more time to rest.
lines.zh: 爸爸妈妈很高兴，也有了更多休息的时间。

lines.en: So I think helping at home makes a family happier.
lines.zh: 所以我觉得在家帮忙能让一家人更快乐。

lines.en: Thank you for listening.
lines.zh: 谢谢大家的聆听。

patterns.en: I help at home because my parents are busy.
patterns.zh: 我在家帮忙，因为爸爸妈妈很忙。

patterns.en: I make my bed because I want a clean room.
patterns.zh: 我整理床铺，因为我想要一个干净的房间。

patterns.en: If we help our parents, they will be happy.
patterns.zh: 如果我们帮助爸爸妈妈，他们就会很高兴。

patterns.en: If we clean our rooms, our home will be nicer.
patterns.zh: 如果我们打扫房间，家里就会更漂亮。

patterns.en: I think helping at home is better than watching TV.
patterns.zh: 我觉得在家帮忙比看电视更好。

lines.en: Good afternoon, everyone.
lines.zh: 大家下午好。

lines.en: Today I want to talk about my grandpa.
lines.zh: 今天我想谈谈我的爷爷。

lines.en: He is seventy years old, but he still works in his garden every day.
lines.zh: 他七十岁了，但每天还在园子里干活。

lines.en: When I was six, he gave me a small part of his garden.
lines.zh: 我六岁时，他把园子的一小块分给了我。

lines.en: He said, "Let's grow some tomatoes together."
lines.zh: 他说：“我们一起种些西红柿吧。”

lines.en: So every morning, we watered the plants together.
lines.zh: 于是每天早上，我们一起给植物浇水。

lines.en: At first, nothing happened, and I wanted to give up.
lines.zh: 一开始，什么变化也没有，我想放弃了。

lines.en: But Grandpa told me, "Good things take time."
lines.zh: 但爷爷对我说：“好东西需要时间。”

lines.en: A few weeks later, small green tomatoes came out.
lines.zh: 几个星期后，小小的青西红柿长出来了。

lines.en: Then they turned red, and we ate them for dinner.
lines.zh: 后来它们变红了，我们把它们做成了晚饭。

lines.en: From that garden, I learned to be patient, just like Grandpa.
lines.zh: 在那个园子里，我学会了像爷爷一样有耐心。

lines.en: Thank you for listening.
lines.zh: 谢谢大家的聆听。

patterns.en: My grandpa taught me to be patient.
patterns.zh: 爷爷教会我要有耐心。

patterns.en: My grandma taught me to cook.
patterns.zh: 奶奶教会我做饭。

patterns.en: I think being patient is better than giving up.
patterns.zh: 我觉得有耐心比放弃更好。

patterns.en: If we wait, good things will come.
patterns.zh: 如果我们耐心等待，好事就会到来。

patterns.en: If we work hard every day, our plants will grow.
patterns.zh: 如果我们每天努力，植物就会生长。

lines.en: Hello, everyone, and good morning.
lines.zh: 大家好，早上好。

lines.en: Let me tell you about a person I admire.
lines.zh: 让我来说说一个我敬佩的人。

lines.en: She is my mother, and she is a nurse in a hospital.
lines.zh: 她就是我的妈妈，她是一家医院的护士。

lines.en: Her work is very hard, so she gets up early and comes back late.
lines.zh: 她的工作很辛苦，所以她早出晚归。

lines.en: But she is never too tired to be kind and patient.
lines.zh: 但她从不会累得失去温柔和耐心。

lines.en: For example, last winter I had a bad cold.
lines.zh: 比如，去年冬天我得了重感冒。

lines.en: She stayed with me all night and made soup for me.
lines.zh: 她整夜陪着我，还给我做了汤。

lines.en: She is kind to other people, too.
lines.zh: 她对别人也很好。

lines.en: When our neighbors need help, she is always the first to help them.
lines.zh: 邻居需要帮助时，她总是第一个去帮忙。

lines.en: She often says to me, "Be kind to others."
lines.zh: 她常对我说：“要善待别人。”

lines.en: I will always remember her words.
lines.zh: 我会永远记住她的话。

lines.en: When I grow up, I want to be like my mother.
lines.zh: 长大后，我想成为像妈妈一样的人。

lines.en: Thank you for listening.
lines.zh: 谢谢大家的聆听。

patterns.en: I admire my mother because she is kind.
patterns.zh: 我敬佩我的妈妈，因为她很善良。

patterns.en: I admire my father because he is brave.
patterns.zh: 我敬佩我的爸爸，因为他很勇敢。

patterns.en: I admire my teacher because she is patient.
patterns.zh: 我敬佩我的老师，因为她很有耐心。

patterns.en: I admire my grandpa because he works hard.
patterns.zh: 我敬佩我的爷爷，因为他工作很努力。

patterns.en: I want to be as kind as my mother.
patterns.zh: 我想像妈妈一样善良。

lines.en: Good morning, everyone.
lines.zh: 大家早上好。

lines.en: Today I want to tell you about a mistake I made.
lines.zh: 今天我想告诉大家我犯过的一个错误。

lines.en: Last winter, we had an important test.
lines.zh: 去年冬天，我们有一场重要的考试。

lines.en: I thought it was easy, so I did not get ready for it.
lines.zh: 我以为它很简单，所以没有好好准备。

lines.en: Instead, I played games every night.
lines.zh: 相反，我每天晚上都在玩游戏。

lines.en: When I got my test back, my mark was very low.
lines.zh: 拿回试卷时，我的分数很低。

lines.en: I was so sad that I wanted to hide it under my bed.
lines.zh: 我难过得想把它藏到床底下。

lines.en: But in the end, I told my mother the truth.
lines.zh: 但最后，我还是把实情告诉了妈妈。

lines.en: To my surprise, she was not angry at all.
lines.zh: 没想到，她一点也没有生气。

lines.en: She helped me make a study plan.
lines.zh: 她帮我制订了一个学习计划。

lines.en: After that, I studied a little every day.
lines.zh: 从那以后，我每天都学一点。

lines.en: In the next test, I did much better.
lines.zh: 在下一次考试中，我考得好多了。

lines.en: Now I know that a mistake can help us grow, if we learn from it.
lines.zh: 现在我明白了，只要我们从错误中学习，错误就能帮助我们成长。

patterns.en: I did not get ready for the test, so I did badly.
patterns.zh: 我没有为考试做准备，所以考得很差。

patterns.en: I told the truth, so I felt better.
patterns.zh: 我说了实话，所以感觉好多了。

patterns.en: I worked hard every day, so I did much better.
patterns.zh: 我每天都努力学习，所以考得好多了。

patterns.en: I think telling the truth is better than keeping a secret.
patterns.zh: 我觉得说实话比藏着秘密更好。

patterns.en: If we learn from our mistakes, we will grow.
patterns.zh: 如果我们从错误中学习，就会成长。

lines.en: Good morning, everyone.
lines.zh: 大家早上好。

lines.en: Today I want to tell you why I love reading.
lines.zh: 今天我想告诉大家我为什么爱读书。

lines.en: First, books take me to new places.
lines.zh: 首先，书带我去新的地方。

lines.en: In a book, I can go to the bottom of the sea or to the moon.
lines.zh: 在书里，我可以去海底，也可以去月球。

lines.en: Books also help me learn new words.
lines.zh: 书还帮我学习新单词。

lines.en: Because I read every day, my English is getting better.
lines.zh: 因为我每天读书，我的英语越来越好。

lines.en: Best of all, reading makes me happy.
lines.zh: 最重要的是，读书让我快乐。

lines.en: When I feel sad, a good story always makes me smile.
lines.zh: 当我难过时，一个好故事总能让我露出笑容。

lines.en: That is why I read for twenty minutes every night before bed.
lines.zh: 所以我每天晚上睡觉前都读二十分钟书。

lines.en: For me, books are like good friends.
lines.zh: 对我来说，书就像好朋友。

lines.en: They are always there when I need them.
lines.zh: 每当我需要它们，它们总在那里。

lines.en: Thank you for listening.
lines.zh: 谢谢大家的聆听。

patterns.en: I love reading because books take me to new places.
patterns.zh: 我爱读书，因为书带我去新的地方。

patterns.en: I love reading because books help me learn new words.
patterns.zh: 我爱读书，因为书帮我学习新单词。

patterns.en: I love reading because stories make me happy.
patterns.zh: 我爱读书，因为故事让我快乐。

patterns.en: If we read every day, we will learn a lot.
patterns.zh: 如果我们每天读书，就会学到很多。

patterns.en: I think reading a book is better than watching TV.
patterns.zh: 我觉得读书比看电视更好。

lines.en: Hello, everyone, and good morning.
lines.zh: 大家好，早上好。

lines.en: Today I want to share some ideas about making friends.
lines.zh: 今天我想和大家分享一些交朋友的想法。

lines.en: Last year, I came to a new school.
lines.zh: 去年，我来到了一所新学校。

lines.en: I had no friends there, and I felt lonely.
lines.zh: 我在那里一个朋友也没有，感到很孤单。

lines.en: Then one day, a girl named Lily smiled at me and said hello.
lines.zh: 后来有一天，一个叫莉莉的女孩笑着跟我打招呼。

lines.en: After that, we started to play together after school.
lines.zh: 从那以后，我们开始在放学后一起玩。

lines.en: Now she is my best friend.
lines.zh: 现在她是我最好的朋友。

lines.en: From her, I learned some things about making friends.
lines.zh: 从她身上，我学到了交朋友的一些道理。

lines.en: First, smile and say hello, just like Lily.
lines.zh: 第一，像莉莉一样微笑着打招呼。

lines.en: Then, listen to others and share with them.
lines.zh: 然后，倾听别人，和别人分享。

lines.en: Also, help your friends when they are in trouble.
lines.zh: 还有，朋友遇到困难时要帮助他们。

lines.en: If you do these things, you will make many friends, too.
lines.zh: 如果你做到这些，你也会交到很多朋友。

patterns.en: If you smile at others, you will make new friends.
patterns.zh: 如果你对别人微笑，就会交到新朋友。

patterns.en: If you share your toys, you will make new friends.
patterns.zh: 如果你分享你的玩具，就会交到新朋友。

patterns.en: If you listen to others, they will like you.
patterns.zh: 如果你倾听别人，他们就会喜欢你。

patterns.en: I think a good friend is someone who helps you.
patterns.zh: 我觉得好朋友就是会帮助你的人。

patterns.en: I think a kind friend is better than a lot of toys.
patterns.zh: 我觉得一个善良的朋友比很多玩具更好。

lines.en: Hello, my friends.
lines.zh: 朋友们好。

lines.en: Today I want to talk about a great invention.
lines.zh: 今天我想谈谈一项伟大的发明。

lines.en: It is something we use every day at school.
lines.zh: 它是我们每天在学校都会用到的东西。

lines.en: It is paper.
lines.zh: 那就是纸。

lines.en: Paper was first made in China a long time ago.
lines.zh: 很久以前，纸最早在中国被造出来。

lines.en: Before that, people wrote on bones, wood or silk.
lines.zh: 在那之前，人们在骨头、木头或丝绸上写字。

lines.en: But bones and wood were heavy, and silk was very expensive.
lines.zh: 但骨头和木头很重，丝绸又非常贵。

lines.en: Paper was lighter and cheaper, so more people could read and write.
lines.zh: 纸更轻也更便宜，所以更多的人能够读书写字了。

lines.en: Today we still use it for books, letters, money and pictures.
lines.zh: 今天我们仍然用它来做书、信、钱和图画。

lines.en: That is why I think paper is a really great invention.
lines.zh: 所以我认为纸真是一项伟大的发明。

lines.en: But paper comes from trees.
lines.zh: 但纸是用树木做成的。

lines.en: So we should not waste it.
lines.zh: 所以我们不应该浪费纸。

lines.en: Thank you for listening.
lines.zh: 谢谢大家的聆听。

patterns.en: I think paper is a great invention because we use it every day.
patterns.zh: 我认为纸是一项伟大的发明，因为我们每天都用它。

patterns.en: I think the light bulb is a great invention because it lights up the night.
patterns.zh: 我认为电灯是一项伟大的发明，因为它照亮了黑夜。

patterns.en: I think the phone is a great invention because we can talk to friends far away.
patterns.zh: 我认为电话是一项伟大的发明，因为我们能和远方的朋友说话。

patterns.en: Paper is lighter than wood.
patterns.zh: 纸比木头轻。

patterns.en: Paper is cheaper than silk.
patterns.zh: 纸比丝绸便宜。

lines.en: Good morning, everyone.
lines.zh: 大家早上好。

lines.en: Today I want to talk about learning English.
lines.zh: 今天我想谈谈学英语。

lines.en: English is a very important language.
lines.zh: 英语是一门非常重要的语言。

lines.en: It is used all over the world.
lines.zh: 全世界都在使用它。

lines.en: But at first, English was hard for me.
lines.zh: 但一开始，英语对我来说很难。

lines.en: At school, I was afraid to speak.
lines.zh: 在学校里，我不敢开口说。

lines.en: Then my teacher had a talk with me.
lines.zh: 后来，老师找我谈了谈。

lines.en: She said, "Don't be afraid of mistakes."
lines.zh: 她说：“不要害怕犯错。”

lines.en: Her words helped me a lot.
lines.zh: 她的话给了我很大的帮助。

lines.en: After that, I listened to English songs and read short stories every day.
lines.zh: 从那以后，我每天听英语歌，读英语小故事。

lines.en: I also started to talk with my friends in English.
lines.zh: 我还开始用英语和朋友们聊天。

lines.en: Now my English is much better than before.
lines.zh: 现在我的英语比以前好多了。

lines.en: So if you keep trying, you will learn English well, too.
lines.zh: 所以，只要你坚持努力，你也会学好英语。

patterns.en: I learn English by listening to songs.
patterns.zh: 我通过听歌学英语。

patterns.en: I learn English by reading stories.
patterns.zh: 我通过读故事学英语。

patterns.en: I learn English by watching cartoons.
patterns.zh: 我通过看动画片学英语。

patterns.en: If we practice every day, we will speak better.
patterns.zh: 如果我们每天练习，就会说得更好。

patterns.en: Speaking is harder than reading, but I like it.
patterns.zh: 说比读更难，但我很喜欢。

lines.en: Dear teachers and friends, good morning.
lines.zh: 亲爱的老师们、同学们，早上好。

lines.en: Today I want to say thank you to our teachers.
lines.zh: 今天我想对我们的老师说声谢谢。

lines.en: Our teachers work very hard for us every day.
lines.zh: 我们的老师每天都为我们辛勤工作。

lines.en: They teach us how to read, write and think.
lines.zh: 他们教我们怎样读、怎样写、怎样思考。

lines.en: They also help us to be good people.
lines.zh: 他们还帮助我们成为好人。

lines.en: I still remember my first day at school.
lines.zh: 我还记得我上学的第一天。

lines.en: I was very sad, and I cried.
lines.zh: 我很难过，还哭了。

lines.en: Then my first teacher held my hand and smiled at me.
lines.zh: 这时，我的第一位老师拉着我的手，对我笑了笑。

lines.en: After that day, I loved school.
lines.zh: 从那天起，我爱上了学校。

lines.en: Even now, when I make mistakes, my teachers do not give up on me.
lines.zh: 直到现在，当我犯错时，老师们也从不放弃我。

lines.en: They say to me, "You can do it!"
lines.zh: 他们对我说：“你能做到！”

lines.en: So our teachers are like candles, giving light to others.
lines.zh: 所以，我们的老师就像蜡烛，照亮别人。

lines.en: Thank you, dear teachers, for all your hard work.
lines.zh: 亲爱的老师们，谢谢你们的辛勤付出。

lines.en: We will work hard and make you proud.
lines.zh: 我们会努力学习，让你们为我们骄傲。

patterns.en: I want to thank my teacher because she is patient.
patterns.zh: 我想感谢我的老师，因为她很有耐心。

patterns.en: I want to thank my teacher because she helps me every day.
patterns.zh: 我想感谢我的老师，因为她每天都帮助我。

patterns.en: I want to thank my teacher because she makes school fun.
patterns.zh: 我想感谢我的老师，因为她让学校生活很有趣。

patterns.en: Thanks to my teacher, I am stronger than before.
patterns.zh: 多亏了我的老师，我比以前更坚强了。

patterns.en: If we work hard in school, our teachers will be happy.
patterns.zh: 如果我们在学校努力学习，老师们就会很高兴。

lines.en: Good afternoon, everyone.
lines.zh: 大家下午好。

lines.en: Let me tell you about my favorite food.
lines.zh: 让我来说说我最喜欢的食物。

lines.en: It is noodles, and my grandma makes the best ones.
lines.zh: 那就是面条，我奶奶做的面条最好吃。

lines.en: She makes noodles for me every Sunday.
lines.zh: 每个星期天，她都给我做面条。

lines.en: She puts eggs, tomatoes and green vegetables in them.
lines.zh: 她在面里放鸡蛋、西红柿和青菜。

lines.en: So her noodles are delicious, and they are good for me, too.
lines.zh: 所以她做的面又好吃，又对我的身体有好处。

lines.en: When I come home cold and tired, hot noodles make me warm.
lines.zh: 当我又冷又累地回到家，热腾腾的面条让我暖和起来。

lines.en: I think noodles are better than hamburgers.
lines.zh: 我觉得面条比汉堡更好。

lines.en: I like them most because Grandma makes them with love.
lines.zh: 我最喜欢它们，因为奶奶是用爱做的。

lines.en: Thank you for listening.
lines.zh: 谢谢大家的聆听。

patterns.en: My favorite food is noodles because they are delicious.
patterns.zh: 我最喜欢的食物是面条，因为它很好吃。

patterns.en: My favorite food is dumplings because my grandma makes them.
patterns.zh: 我最喜欢的食物是饺子，因为是奶奶包的。

patterns.en: My favorite fruit is watermelon because it is sweet.
patterns.zh: 我最喜欢的水果是西瓜，因为它很甜。

patterns.en: I think noodles are better than hamburgers.
patterns.zh: 我觉得面条比汉堡更好。

patterns.en: I think fruit is better than candy.
patterns.zh: 我觉得水果比糖果更好。

lines.en: Good morning, everyone.
lines.zh: 大家早上好。

lines.en: Did you have breakfast this morning?
lines.zh: 今天早上你吃早饭了吗？

lines.en: I ask this because breakfast is the most important meal of the day.
lines.zh: 我这样问，是因为早饭是一天中最重要的一餐。

lines.en: But some children do not eat it, because they get up late.
lines.zh: 但有些孩子不吃早饭，因为他们起得太晚。

lines.en: Then they feel hungry and tired in class.
lines.zh: 结果他们在课堂上又饿又累。

lines.en: I was like that last year, too.
lines.zh: 去年我也是这样。

lines.en: So now I get up early and eat a healthy breakfast.
lines.zh: 所以现在我早早起床，吃一顿健康的早饭。

lines.en: It is easy to make.
lines.zh: 它很容易做。

lines.en: I have milk, an egg and some bread.
lines.zh: 我喝牛奶，吃一个鸡蛋和一些面包。

lines.en: Sometimes I have a banana or an apple, too.
lines.zh: 有时我还吃一根香蕉或一个苹果。

lines.en: Now I am never hungry in class, and I can learn better.
lines.zh: 现在我上课再也不饿了，学习也更好了。

lines.en: So let's eat a healthy breakfast every day!
lines.zh: 所以，让我们每天都吃一顿健康的早饭吧！

patterns.en: If we eat breakfast, we will not feel hungry in class.
patterns.zh: 如果我们吃早饭，上课就不会饿。

patterns.en: If we drink milk, we will grow strong.
patterns.zh: 如果我们喝牛奶，就会长得强壮。

patterns.en: If we eat fruit, we will be healthy.
patterns.zh: 如果我们吃水果，就会很健康。

patterns.en: I think an egg is better than a cake for breakfast.
patterns.zh: 我觉得早饭吃鸡蛋比吃蛋糕更好。

patterns.en: I have bread and milk for breakfast because they are good for me.
patterns.zh: 我早饭吃面包、喝牛奶，因为它们对我有好处。

lines.en: Good morning, boys and girls.
lines.zh: 同学们，早上好。

lines.en: How can we stay healthy?
lines.zh: 我们怎样才能保持健康呢？

lines.en: I think the answer is good habits.
lines.zh: 我觉得答案就是好习惯。

lines.en: First, we should wash our hands before we eat.
lines.zh: 首先，吃东西之前我们应该洗手。

lines.en: Then, at meals, we should eat more vegetables and less candy.
lines.zh: 然后，吃饭时我们应该多吃蔬菜，少吃糖。

lines.en: After dinner, it is good to go for a walk.
lines.zh: 晚饭后，出去散散步很好。

lines.en: At night, we should go to bed early.
lines.zh: 晚上，我们应该早点睡觉。

lines.en: That is because sleep helps our bodies grow.
lines.zh: 那是因为睡眠能帮助我们的身体成长。

lines.en: I also play football with my friends after school.
lines.zh: 我还会在放学后和朋友们踢足球。

lines.en: Because of these habits, I am taller and stronger than last year.
lines.zh: 因为这些好习惯，我比去年更高、更强壮了。

lines.en: So if we keep good habits, we will be healthy and happy.
lines.zh: 所以，只要我们保持好习惯，就会健康又快乐。

lines.en: Thank you for listening.
lines.zh: 谢谢大家的聆听。

patterns.en: We should wash our hands because we want to be healthy.
patterns.zh: 我们应该洗手，因为我们想保持健康。

patterns.en: We should eat more vegetables because they are good for us.
patterns.zh: 我们应该多吃蔬菜，因为蔬菜对我们有好处。

patterns.en: If we go to bed early, we will feel better the next day.
patterns.zh: 如果我们早点睡觉，第二天就会感觉更好。

patterns.en: If we play sports every day, we will grow stronger.
patterns.zh: 如果我们每天运动，就会变得更强壮。

patterns.en: I think walking after dinner is better than sitting all evening.
patterns.zh: 我觉得晚饭后散步比整晚坐着更好。

lines.en: Hello, my friends.
lines.zh: 朋友们好。

lines.en: Today I want to talk about food.
lines.zh: 今天我想谈谈食物。

lines.en: Every day, a lot of food is wasted.
lines.zh: 每天都有很多食物被浪费。

lines.en: Some children do not finish their rice, and they put it in the bin.
lines.zh: 有些孩子吃不完米饭，就把它倒进垃圾桶。

lines.en: But many people in the world do not have enough food.
lines.zh: 但世界上还有很多人吃不饱。

lines.en: And farmers work very hard to grow our rice and vegetables.
lines.zh: 而且农民要非常辛苦地种出我们的米饭和蔬菜。

lines.en: So we should not waste any food.
lines.zh: 所以我们不应该浪费任何食物。

lines.en: What can we do?
lines.zh: 我们能做些什么呢？

lines.en: First, we should only take the food we can finish.
lines.zh: 首先，我们应该只拿自己吃得完的食物。

lines.en: If we cannot finish it, we can take it home.
lines.zh: 如果吃不完，可以把它带回家。

lines.en: Also, we should not buy too much food at the supermarket.
lines.zh: 还有，我们在超市不应该买太多食物。

lines.en: If everyone does these small things, we will save a lot of food.
lines.zh: 如果每个人都做到这些小事，我们就能节约很多食物。

lines.en: Thank you for listening.
lines.zh: 谢谢大家的聆听。

patterns.en: We should not waste food because farmers work hard.
patterns.zh: 我们不应该浪费食物，因为农民很辛苦。

patterns.en: We should finish our food because many people are hungry.
patterns.zh: 我们应该吃完饭菜，因为很多人还在挨饿。

patterns.en: If we take only what we can eat, we will not waste food.
patterns.zh: 如果我们只拿吃得完的，就不会浪费食物。

patterns.en: If we cannot finish our dinner, we can take it home.
patterns.zh: 如果我们吃不完晚饭，可以带回家。

patterns.en: I think saving food is better than wasting it.
patterns.zh: 我觉得节约食物比浪费食物好。

lines.en: Hello, boys and girls.
lines.zh: 同学们好。

lines.en: Today I want to talk about screen time.
lines.zh: 今天我想谈谈屏幕时间。

lines.en: Many children use phones every day.
lines.zh: 很多孩子每天都在用手机。

lines.en: Phones can be very useful, because we can learn new things on them.
lines.zh: 手机可以非常有用，因为我们能用它们学习新知识。

lines.en: But too much screen time is bad for our health.
lines.zh: 但是屏幕时间太长对我们的健康有害。

lines.en: It is bad for our eyes, and we may not sleep well.
lines.zh: 它对我们的眼睛不好，我们也可能睡不好。

lines.en: We also have less time to play outside.
lines.zh: 我们在户外玩的时间也变少了。

lines.en: I know this well, because it was true for me.
lines.zh: 我很清楚这一点，因为我自己就是这样。

lines.en: Last year, I played on my phone for hours every day.
lines.zh: 去年，我每天都要玩好几个小时手机。

lines.en: My eyes were often tired, and I was always sleepy in class.
lines.zh: 我的眼睛常常很累，上课时总是犯困。

lines.en: So now I only use my phone for half an hour a day.
lines.zh: 所以现在我每天只用半个小时手机。

lines.en: After school, I read books and play football instead.
lines.zh: 放学后，我改成读书和踢足球。

lines.en: I am stronger and happier than before.
lines.zh: 我比以前更强壮、更快乐了。

lines.en: So let's put down our phones and go outside!
lines.zh: 所以，让我们放下手机，到户外去吧！

patterns.en: I think playing outside is better than playing on the phone.
patterns.zh: 我觉得在户外玩比玩手机更好。

patterns.en: I think reading a book is better than watching videos.
patterns.zh: 我觉得读书比看视频更好。

patterns.en: If we use screens too much, our eyes will get tired.
patterns.zh: 如果我们用屏幕太多，眼睛就会累。

patterns.en: If we go to bed early, we will feel better.
patterns.zh: 如果我们早点睡觉，就会感觉更好。

patterns.en: We should use screens for under an hour a day.
patterns.zh: 我们每天使用屏幕应该少于一个小时。

lines.en: Hello, everyone, and good afternoon.
lines.zh: 大家好，下午好。

lines.en: My favorite animal is the panda.
lines.zh: 我最喜欢的动物是大熊猫。

lines.en: Pandas live in the forests of China.
lines.zh: 大熊猫生活在中国的森林里。

lines.en: They are black and white, and they look very cute.
lines.zh: 它们黑白相间，看起来非常可爱。

lines.en: They are big, but they are very friendly.
lines.zh: 它们个子很大，但非常友善。

lines.en: Every day, they eat bamboo for many hours.
lines.zh: 每天，它们要花很多个小时吃竹子。

lines.en: Last summer, I saw two pandas at the zoo.
lines.zh: 去年夏天，我在动物园看到了两只大熊猫。

lines.en: One was eating bamboo, and the other was sleeping in a tree.
lines.zh: 一只在吃竹子，另一只在树上睡觉。

lines.en: There are not many pandas in the world, so we must take good care of them.
lines.zh: 世界上的大熊猫不多，所以我们一定要好好保护它们。

lines.en: Thank you for listening.
lines.zh: 谢谢大家的聆听。

patterns.en: My favorite animal is the panda because it is cute.
patterns.zh: 我最喜欢的动物是大熊猫，因为它很可爱。

patterns.en: My favorite animal is the rabbit because it is soft.
patterns.zh: 我最喜欢的动物是兔子，因为它软软的。

patterns.en: My favorite animal is the elephant because it is clever.
patterns.zh: 我最喜欢的动物是大象，因为它很聪明。

patterns.en: My favorite animal is the dog because it is friendly.
patterns.zh: 我最喜欢的动物是狗，因为它很友好。

patterns.en: I think pandas are cuter than bears.
patterns.zh: 我觉得大熊猫比熊更可爱。

lines.en: Good morning, everyone.
lines.zh: 大家早上好。

lines.en: Today I want to talk about trees.
lines.zh: 今天我想谈谈树。

lines.en: Trees are very important to us.
lines.zh: 树对我们非常重要。

lines.en: They give us fresh air, and they keep us cool in summer.
lines.zh: 它们给我们清新的空气，夏天还让我们感到凉爽。

lines.en: They are also homes for birds and many other animals.
lines.zh: 它们还是鸟儿和许多其他动物的家。

lines.en: That is why my class planted ten trees near our school last spring.
lines.zh: 所以去年春天，我们班在学校附近种了十棵树。

lines.en: After that, we gave them water every week.
lines.zh: 从那以后，我们每周都给它们浇水。

lines.en: Now the little trees are growing taller and greener.
lines.zh: 现在，小树长得越来越高、越来越绿。

lines.en: Some birds even live in them now.
lines.zh: 现在甚至有鸟儿住在上面了。

lines.en: If everyone plants a tree, our world will be greener.
lines.zh: 如果每个人都种一棵树，我们的世界就会更绿。

lines.en: So let's plant more trees together!
lines.zh: 所以，让我们一起种更多的树吧！

patterns.en: If we plant more trees, the air will be cleaner.
patterns.zh: 如果我们多种树，空气就会更干净。

patterns.en: If we plant more trees, birds will have more homes.
patterns.zh: 如果我们多种树，鸟儿就会有更多的家。

patterns.en: If we cut down trees, animals will lose their homes.
patterns.zh: 如果我们砍树，动物就会失去家园。

patterns.en: I think a city with trees is better than a city without trees.
patterns.zh: 我觉得有树的城市比没有树的城市更好。

patterns.en: Trees are important because they give us fresh air.
patterns.zh: 树很重要，因为它们给我们清新的空气。

lines.en: Hello, boys and girls.
lines.zh: 同学们好。

lines.en: Do you love animals?
lines.zh: 你爱动物吗？

lines.en: I love them very much, because they are our friends.
lines.zh: 我非常爱它们，因为它们是我们的朋友。

lines.en: Like us, they can feel pain and fear.
lines.zh: 它们和我们一样，也会感到疼痛和害怕。

lines.en: Last week, I saw a little cat in the rain.
lines.zh: 上个星期，我在雨里看到一只小猫。

lines.en: It was cold and hungry.
lines.zh: 它又冷又饿。

lines.en: So my brother and I gave it some milk and a warm box.
lines.zh: 所以我和哥哥给了它一些牛奶和一个暖和的箱子。

lines.en: Now it is happy and healthy in our house.
lines.zh: 现在它在我们家里过得又快乐又健康。

lines.en: From this little cat, I learned that animals need our help.
lines.zh: 从这只小猫身上，我明白了动物需要我们的帮助。

lines.en: So we should never hurt them.
lines.zh: 所以我们永远不应该伤害它们。

lines.en: And if we have a pet, we must take good care of it.
lines.zh: 如果我们养宠物，就一定要好好照顾它。

lines.en: Let's make the world a better place for animals!
lines.zh: 让我们把世界变成动物们更美好的地方！

patterns.en: We should be kind to animals because they are our friends.
patterns.zh: 我们应该善待动物，因为它们是我们的朋友。

patterns.en: We should never hurt animals because they feel pain.
patterns.zh: 我们永远不应该伤害动物，因为它们会感到疼痛。

patterns.en: If we have a pet, we should give it food every day.
patterns.zh: 如果我们养宠物，就应该每天喂它。

patterns.en: If we see a hungry cat, we can give it some milk.
patterns.zh: 如果我们看到一只饥饿的猫，可以给它一些牛奶。

patterns.en: If we see a lost dog, we can ask a grown-up for help.
patterns.zh: 如果我们看到一只走失的狗，可以请大人帮忙。

lines.en: Good morning, everyone.
lines.zh: 大家早上好。

lines.en: Today I want to talk about saving water.
lines.zh: 今天我想谈谈节约用水。

lines.en: Water is very important to us.
lines.zh: 水对我们非常重要。

lines.en: People, animals and plants all need it.
lines.zh: 人、动物和植物都需要它。

lines.en: But in some places, there is not enough clean water.
lines.zh: 但在一些地方，干净的水并不够用。

lines.en: So we must not waste it.
lines.zh: 所以我们一定不能浪费水。

lines.en: How can we save water?
lines.zh: 我们怎样才能节约用水呢？

lines.en: First, we should turn off the tap when we brush our teeth.
lines.zh: 首先，刷牙时我们应该关掉水龙头。

lines.en: Then, we can take shorter showers.
lines.zh: 然后，我们可以缩短洗澡的时间。

lines.en: We can also use the water from washing fruit for the flowers.
lines.zh: 我们还可以用洗水果的水来浇花。

lines.en: If everyone saves a little water like this, we will save a lot.
lines.zh: 如果每个人都这样节约一点水，我们就能节约很多。

lines.en: So let's start today!
lines.zh: 所以，让我们从今天做起！

patterns.en: If we turn off the tap, we will save water.
patterns.zh: 如果我们关掉水龙头，就能节约用水。

patterns.en: If we take shorter showers, we will save water.
patterns.zh: 如果我们缩短洗澡时间，就能节约用水。

patterns.en: If we use less water, we will help the earth.
patterns.zh: 如果我们少用水，就能帮助地球。

patterns.en: We should turn off the tap when we brush our teeth.
patterns.zh: 刷牙时我们应该关掉水龙头。

patterns.en: Saving water is easier than you think.
patterns.zh: 节约用水比你想象的更容易。

lines.en: Good morning, everyone.
lines.zh: 大家早上好。

lines.en: The earth is our home, and we only have one.
lines.zh: 地球是我们的家园，而我们只有一个地球。

lines.en: But today, there is so much rubbish on the land and in the sea.
lines.zh: 但如今，陆地上和海洋里有那么多垃圾。

lines.en: Some fish and birds get ill because they eat plastic.
lines.zh: 一些鱼和鸟因为吃了塑料而生病。

lines.en: So we need to keep our earth clean.
lines.zh: 所以我们需要保持地球清洁。

lines.en: What can we do?
lines.zh: 我们能做些什么呢？

lines.en: First, we can put rubbish in the right bins.
lines.zh: 首先，我们可以把垃圾扔进正确的垃圾桶。

lines.en: Second, we can take our own bags when we go shopping.
lines.zh: 其次，购物时我们可以带上自己的袋子。

lines.en: Last, we can walk to school instead of going by car.
lines.zh: 最后，我们可以走路上学，而不是坐汽车。

lines.en: My friends and I tried something more last month.
lines.zh: 上个月，我和朋友们还做了更多。

lines.en: We cleaned up a park near our school, and it looked much cleaner after that.
lines.zh: 我们清扫了学校附近的一个公园，之后公园干净多了。

lines.en: So if we all do a little, the earth will be a better place.
lines.zh: 所以，只要我们每个人都出一份力，地球就会变得更美好。

lines.en: Let's work together!
lines.zh: 让我们一起努力吧！

patterns.en: If we put rubbish in bins, the earth will be cleaner.
patterns.zh: 如果我们把垃圾扔进垃圾桶，地球就会更干净。

patterns.en: If we plant trees, the air will be cleaner.
patterns.zh: 如果我们种树，空气就会更干净。

patterns.en: If we take our own bags, we will use less plastic.
patterns.zh: 如果我们自带袋子，就会少用塑料。

patterns.en: I think walking to school is better than going by car.
patterns.zh: 我觉得走路上学比坐汽车更好。

patterns.en: We should take our own bags when we go shopping.
patterns.zh: 购物时我们应该自带袋子。

lines.en: Hello, my friends.
lines.zh: 朋友们好。

lines.en: Do you like rainy days?
lines.zh: 你喜欢下雨天吗？

lines.en: Many people do not like rain, but I do.
lines.zh: 很多人不喜欢下雨，但我喜欢。

lines.en: Last Saturday, it rained all day.
lines.zh: 上个星期六，下了一整天的雨。

lines.en: We could not go to the park, so I stayed at home with my brother.
lines.zh: 我们没法去公园，所以我和弟弟待在家里。

lines.en: First, we read some funny books together.
lines.zh: 首先，我们一起读了一些有趣的书。

lines.en: Then we made paper boats and put them in the water outside.
lines.zh: 然后，我们折了纸船，把它们放进外面的水里。

lines.en: After the rain, the air was fresh and cool.
lines.zh: 雨停了，空气清新又凉爽。

lines.en: We even saw a rainbow in the sky.
lines.zh: 我们甚至看到了天上的彩虹。

lines.en: So I think rainy days can be really fun.
lines.zh: 所以我觉得下雨天也可以很有趣。

patterns.en: If it rains, I will stay at home and read.
patterns.zh: 如果下雨，我就待在家里读书。

patterns.en: If it rains, we will make paper boats.
patterns.zh: 如果下雨，我们就折纸船。

patterns.en: If it is sunny, we will go to the park.
patterns.zh: 如果天晴，我们就去公园。

patterns.en: I think a rainy day can be as fun as a sunny day.
patterns.zh: 我觉得下雨天也能和晴天一样有趣。

lines.en: Good morning, everyone.
lines.zh: 大家早上好。

lines.en: Let me tell you about a snowy day last winter.
lines.zh: 让我来说说去年冬天的一个下雪天。

lines.en: When I got up that morning, everything outside was white.
lines.zh: 那天早上起床时，外面的一切都是白色的。

lines.en: It was still snowing hard.
lines.zh: 雪还下得很大。

lines.en: So I put on my warm jacket and ran outside.
lines.zh: 于是我穿上暖和的夹克，跑到外面。

lines.en: My friends were already there, and we made a big snowman together.
lines.zh: 朋友们已经在那里了，我们一起堆了一个大雪人。

lines.en: We gave him a carrot nose and two black eyes.
lines.zh: 我们给他安上胡萝卜鼻子和两只黑眼睛。

lines.en: After that, we played in the snow for hours.
lines.zh: 之后，我们在雪地里玩了好几个小时。

lines.en: My hands were cold, but I was very happy.
lines.zh: 我的手冻得冰凉，但我非常开心。

lines.en: When I got home, Mom made hot chocolate for me.
lines.zh: 回到家，妈妈给我做了热巧克力。

lines.en: It was the best day of the winter.
lines.zh: 那是整个冬天最棒的一天。

patterns.en: When it snows, I like to make a snowman.
patterns.zh: 下雪时，我喜欢堆雪人。

patterns.en: When it is sunny, I like to fly a kite.
patterns.zh: 天晴时，我喜欢放风筝。

patterns.en: When it is windy, I like to stay at home.
patterns.zh: 刮风时，我喜欢待在家里。

patterns.en: If it snows tomorrow, we will play outside.
patterns.zh: 如果明天下雪，我们就到外面玩。

patterns.en: I think snowy days are more exciting than rainy days.
patterns.zh: 我觉得下雪天比下雨天更令人兴奋。

lines.en: Hello, my friends.
lines.zh: 朋友们好。

lines.en: Which season do you like best?
lines.zh: 你最喜欢哪个季节？

lines.en: For me, autumn is the best season.
lines.zh: 对我来说，秋天是最好的季节。

lines.en: That is because it is cooler than summer and warmer than winter.
lines.zh: 那是因为它比夏天凉快，比冬天暖和。

lines.en: In autumn, the sky is blue, and the leaves turn red and yellow.
lines.zh: 秋天，天空蓝蓝的，树叶变成了红色和黄色。

lines.en: Apples and oranges are ready to eat, too.
lines.zh: 苹果和橙子也熟了。

lines.en: So my family often goes for a walk in the park.
lines.zh: 所以我们一家人常常去公园散步。

lines.en: There, we pick up beautiful leaves and make pictures with them.
lines.zh: 在那里，我们捡来漂亮的树叶，用它们拼成图画。

lines.en: Spring is lovely, but autumn is more colorful.
lines.zh: 春天很可爱，但秋天更加多彩。

lines.en: That is why autumn is the season I love most.
lines.zh: 这就是秋天是我最爱的季节的原因。

lines.en: What about you?
lines.zh: 你呢？

patterns.en: I like autumn best because it is cool.
patterns.zh: 我最喜欢秋天，因为天气凉爽。

patterns.en: I like spring best because the flowers are beautiful.
patterns.zh: 我最喜欢春天，因为花儿很美。

patterns.en: I like summer best because I can swim.
patterns.zh: 我最喜欢夏天，因为我可以游泳。

patterns.en: I like winter best because I can play in the snow.
patterns.zh: 我最喜欢冬天，因为我可以在雪里玩。

patterns.en: Autumn is cooler than summer.
patterns.zh: 秋天比夏天凉快。

lines.en: Good afternoon, everyone.
lines.zh: 大家下午好。

lines.en: Today I want to talk about the weather and our clothes.
lines.zh: 今天我想谈谈天气和我们的衣服。

lines.en: The weather changes every day, so our clothes should change, too.
lines.zh: 天气每天都在变，所以我们的衣服也应该跟着变。

lines.en: When it is hot and sunny, I wear a T-shirt and a hat.
lines.zh: 天气又热又晴时，我穿T恤、戴帽子。

lines.en: When it is cold, I wear a sweater and a warm jacket.
lines.zh: 天冷时，我穿毛衣和暖和的夹克。

lines.en: And when it rains, I take an umbrella.
lines.zh: 下雨时，我会带上雨伞。

lines.en: But one day last week, I forgot to check the weather.
lines.zh: 但上周有一天，我忘了看天气。

lines.en: I wore a thin shirt to school, and it suddenly got very cold.
lines.zh: 我穿着一件薄衬衫去上学，结果天突然变得很冷。

lines.en: I was cold all day, and the next day I had a bad cold.
lines.zh: 我冷了一整天，第二天就得了重感冒。

lines.en: Since then, I always check the weather before I go out.
lines.zh: 从那以后，我出门前总会先看看天气。

lines.en: If we wear the right clothes, we will stay healthy.
lines.zh: 如果我们穿对衣服，就能保持健康。

lines.en: Thank you for listening.
lines.zh: 谢谢大家的聆听。

patterns.en: When it is cold, I wear a warm jacket.
patterns.zh: 天冷时，我穿暖和的夹克。

patterns.en: When it is sunny, I wear a hat.
patterns.zh: 天晴时，我戴帽子。

patterns.en: When it rains, I take an umbrella.
patterns.zh: 下雨时，我带雨伞。

patterns.en: If we wear the right clothes, we will not catch a cold.
patterns.zh: 如果我们穿对衣服，就不会感冒。

patterns.en: I think a warm sweater is better than a thin shirt in winter.
patterns.zh: 我觉得冬天穿暖和的毛衣比穿薄衬衫好。

lines.en: Good morning, boys and girls.
lines.zh: 同学们，早上好。

lines.en: Which do you like better, summer or winter?
lines.zh: 夏天和冬天，你更喜欢哪一个？

lines.en: My friend Amy likes summer, but I like winter better.
lines.zh: 我的朋友艾米喜欢夏天，但我更喜欢冬天。

lines.en: Let me tell you why.
lines.zh: 让我来告诉你为什么。

lines.en: First, I do not like hot weather.
lines.zh: 首先，我不喜欢炎热的天气。

lines.en: In summer, it is too hot, and I often feel tired.
lines.zh: 夏天太热了，我常常觉得很累。

lines.en: But in winter, the air is cold and fresh.
lines.zh: 但在冬天，空气又冷又清新。

lines.en: Second, I can play in the snow in winter, and snow is more fun than rain.
lines.zh: 其次，冬天我可以在雪里玩，而雪比雨好玩多了。

lines.en: Third, winter brings the Spring Festival.
lines.zh: 第三，冬天会迎来春节。

lines.en: At that time, we wear new clothes and eat delicious food with our family.
lines.zh: 那时，我们穿新衣服，和家人一起吃美食。

lines.en: Of course, summer has a long holiday, and Amy can swim every day.
lines.zh: 当然，夏天有长长的假期，艾米每天都能游泳。

lines.en: But I still think winter is the best.
lines.zh: 但我还是觉得冬天最好。

lines.en: Which one do you like?
lines.zh: 你喜欢哪一个呢？

patterns.en: I like winter better than summer because I can play in the snow.
patterns.zh: 比起夏天，我更喜欢冬天，因为我可以在雪里玩。

patterns.en: I like summer better than winter because I can swim.
patterns.zh: 比起冬天，我更喜欢夏天，因为我可以游泳。

patterns.en: Winter is colder than summer, but it is more fun.
patterns.zh: 冬天比夏天冷，但更好玩。

patterns.en: Summer is hotter than spring, so I often feel tired.
patterns.zh: 夏天比春天热，所以我常常觉得累。

patterns.en: I think winter is the best season because of the Spring Festival.
patterns.zh: 我觉得冬天是最好的季节，因为有春节。

lines.en: Good afternoon, my friends.
lines.zh: 朋友们，下午好。

lines.en: Everyone has a hobby, and mine is drawing.
lines.zh: 每个人都有爱好，我的爱好是画画。

lines.en: I started to draw when I was five.
lines.zh: 我五岁时开始画画。

lines.en: At first, I only drew cats and flowers.
lines.zh: 一开始，我只画猫和花。

lines.en: Now I can draw people, too, and I often draw my family.
lines.zh: 现在我也会画人了，还常常画我的家人。

lines.en: Every Saturday, I go to an art class to learn more.
lines.zh: 每个星期六，我都去上美术课，学更多东西。

lines.en: My teacher says my pictures are getting better.
lines.zh: 老师说我的画越来越好了。

lines.en: Last month, one of my pictures was in a school show.
lines.zh: 上个月，我的一幅画参加了学校的画展。

lines.en: I was very proud, and my parents were happy, too.
lines.zh: 我非常自豪，爸爸妈妈也很高兴。

lines.en: Drawing makes me quiet and happy.
lines.zh: 画画让我安静又快乐。

lines.en: So I will keep drawing, and maybe one day I will be a painter.
lines.zh: 所以我会一直画下去，也许有一天我会成为一名画家。

patterns.en: My hobby is drawing because it makes me happy.
patterns.zh: 我的爱好是画画，因为它让我快乐。

patterns.en: My hobby is singing because I love music.
patterns.zh: 我的爱好是唱歌，因为我爱音乐。

patterns.en: My hobby is dancing because it is fun.
patterns.zh: 我的爱好是跳舞，因为它很有趣。

patterns.en: I think drawing is more fun than watching TV.
patterns.zh: 我觉得画画比看电视更有趣。

patterns.en: If I practice every day, my pictures will get better.
patterns.zh: 如果我每天练习，我的画就会越来越好。

lines.en: Good morning, everyone.
lines.zh: 大家早上好。

lines.en: Do you like flying kites?
lines.zh: 你喜欢放风筝吗？

lines.en: I love it, and spring is the best time for it.
lines.zh: 我很喜欢，而春天是放风筝最好的季节。

lines.en: Last Sunday, my dad and I made a kite together.
lines.zh: 上个星期天，我和爸爸一起做了一只风筝。

lines.en: First, we got some thin sticks and colorful paper.
lines.zh: 首先，我们找来一些细木条和彩纸。

lines.en: Then we put the paper on the sticks and gave the kite a long tail.
lines.zh: 然后，我们把彩纸糊在木条上，还给风筝加了一条长尾巴。

lines.en: In the afternoon, we took it to the park.
lines.zh: 下午，我们把它带到了公园。

lines.en: At first, our kite fell down two times.
lines.zh: 一开始，我们的风筝掉下来了两次。

lines.en: But we did not give up, and we tried again.
lines.zh: 但我们没有放弃，又试了一次。

lines.en: At last, the wind was strong, and our kite went up into the sky.
lines.zh: 最后，风很大，我们的风筝飞上了天空。

lines.en: I was so happy that I jumped and shouted.
lines.zh: 我高兴得又跳又叫。

lines.en: Now I think making a kite is even more fun than flying it.
lines.zh: 现在我觉得做风筝比放风筝还要有趣。

patterns.en: I like flying kites because it is fun.
patterns.zh: 我喜欢放风筝，因为很有趣。

patterns.en: I like flying kites because I can be outside.
patterns.zh: 我喜欢放风筝，因为我可以待在户外。

patterns.en: If the wind is strong, the kite will fly high.
patterns.zh: 如果风大，风筝就会飞得很高。

patterns.en: If we do not give up, our kite will go up into the sky.
patterns.zh: 如果我们不放弃，风筝就会飞上天空。

patterns.en: I think making a kite is more fun than buying one.
patterns.zh: 我觉得自己做风筝比买风筝更有趣。

lines.en: Good afternoon, everyone.
lines.zh: 大家下午好。

lines.en: My favorite story is The Lion and the Mouse.
lines.zh: 我最喜欢的故事是《狮子和老鼠》。

lines.en: One day, a lion caught a little mouse.
lines.zh: 有一天，一头狮子抓住了一只小老鼠。

lines.en: The mouse said, "Please let me go, and I will help you one day."
lines.zh: 老鼠说：“请放了我吧，总有一天我会帮助你的。”

lines.en: The lion laughed at this, but he let the mouse go.
lines.zh: 狮子听了哈哈大笑，但还是放走了老鼠。

lines.en: Some days later, the lion was caught in a net.
lines.zh: 几天后，狮子被一张网困住了。

lines.en: He tried and tried, but he could not get out.
lines.zh: 他试了一次又一次，可就是出不来。

lines.en: Then the little mouse came and cut the net with its teeth.
lines.zh: 这时，小老鼠跑来，用牙齿咬断了网。

lines.en: At last, the lion was free.
lines.zh: 最后，狮子自由了。

lines.en: So the little mouse did help the big lion.
lines.zh: 就这样，小老鼠真的帮助了大狮子。

lines.en: I like this story because it shows that small friends can be a great help.
lines.zh: 我喜欢这个故事，因为它告诉我们，小小的朋友也能帮上大忙。

lines.en: Thank you for listening.
lines.zh: 谢谢大家的聆听。

patterns.en: I like this story because it is funny.
patterns.zh: 我喜欢这个故事，因为它很有趣。

patterns.en: I like this story because the mouse is kind.
patterns.zh: 我喜欢这个故事，因为老鼠很善良。

patterns.en: I like this story because the mouse is brave.
patterns.zh: 我喜欢这个故事，因为老鼠很勇敢。

patterns.en: This story shows that small friends can be a great help.
patterns.zh: 这个故事告诉我们，小小的朋友也能帮上大忙。

patterns.en: I think the mouse is braver than the lion.
patterns.zh: 我觉得老鼠比狮子更勇敢。

lines.en: Hello, boys and girls.
lines.zh: 同学们好。

lines.en: Do you like sports?
lines.zh: 你喜欢运动吗？

lines.en: I love sports, and I play badminton every day.
lines.zh: 我爱运动，每天都打羽毛球。

lines.en: Today I want to tell you why.
lines.zh: 今天我想告诉大家为什么。

lines.en: First, sports make us healthy and strong.
lines.zh: 首先，运动让我们健康又强壮。

lines.en: I used to get colds very often.
lines.zh: 我以前常常感冒。

lines.en: But since I started playing badminton, I am almost never ill.
lines.zh: 但自从我开始打羽毛球，我几乎再也没生过病。

lines.en: Second, sports help us make friends.
lines.zh: 其次，运动帮助我们交朋友。

lines.en: At the badminton club, I met many new friends.
lines.zh: 在羽毛球俱乐部，我认识了很多新朋友。

lines.en: Third, sports teach us not to give up.
lines.zh: 第三，运动教会我们不要放弃。

lines.en: At first, I lost many games, but I kept practicing.
lines.zh: 一开始，我输了很多场比赛，但我坚持练习。

lines.en: Now I often win, and I am more confident.
lines.zh: 现在我常常赢，也更有自信了。

lines.en: So let's play sports together!
lines.zh: 所以，让我们一起运动吧！

patterns.en: I love sports because they make me strong.
patterns.zh: 我爱运动，因为运动让我强壮。

patterns.en: I love badminton because I can play with my friends.
patterns.zh: 我爱羽毛球，因为我可以和朋友们一起玩。

patterns.en: I love swimming because it is cool in summer.
patterns.zh: 我爱游泳，因为夏天游泳很凉快。

patterns.en: If we play sports every day, we will be healthier.
patterns.zh: 如果我们每天运动，就会更健康。

patterns.en: I think playing outside is better than sitting at home.
patterns.zh: 我觉得在户外玩比坐在家里更好。

lines.en: Hello, everyone, and good morning.
lines.zh: 大家好，早上好。

lines.en: Today I want to talk about teamwork.
lines.zh: 今天我想谈谈团队合作。

lines.en: Last month, we had a basketball match at school.
lines.zh: 上个月，我们在学校参加了一场篮球比赛。

lines.en: At first, we did not play well.
lines.zh: 一开始，我们打得不好。

lines.en: That was because everyone wanted to keep the ball.
lines.zh: 那是因为每个人都想自己拿着球。

lines.en: So we were behind at half time.
lines.zh: 所以到中场时我们落后了。

lines.en: Then our teacher said to us, "Play as a team!"
lines.zh: 这时，老师对我们说：“要像一个团队那样打球！”

lines.en: So in the second half, we passed the ball to each other.
lines.zh: 于是下半场，我们互相传球。

lines.en: We helped each other and worked together.
lines.zh: 我们互相帮助，齐心协力。

lines.en: At last, we won the match!
lines.zh: 最后，我们赢得了比赛！

lines.en: From this match, I learned that a team is stronger than one person.
lines.zh: 从这场比赛中，我明白了一个团队比一个人更强大。

lines.en: If we work together, we can do great things.
lines.zh: 如果我们齐心协力，就能做成大事。

lines.en: So let's always work as a team.
lines.zh: 所以，让我们永远像一个团队一样合作。

lines.en: Thank you for listening.
lines.zh: 谢谢大家的聆听。

patterns.en: If we work together, we will be stronger.
patterns.zh: 如果我们齐心协力，就会更强大。

patterns.en: If we help each other, we will do better.
patterns.zh: 如果我们互相帮助，就会做得更好。

patterns.en: If we talk to each other, we will be a better team.
patterns.zh: 如果我们互相交流，就会成为更好的团队。

patterns.en: A team is stronger than one person.
patterns.zh: 一个团队比一个人更强大。

patterns.en: I think working together is better than working alone.
patterns.zh: 我觉得一起合作比单独干更好。

lines.en: Good morning, my friends.
lines.zh: 朋友们，早上好。

lines.en: Let me tell you about my home.
lines.zh: 让我来说说我的家。

lines.en: I live on the sixth floor of a tall building.
lines.zh: 我住在一栋高楼的六层。

lines.en: It is not very big, but it is warm and bright.
lines.zh: 它不太大，但温暖又明亮。

lines.en: There are three bedrooms, a kitchen and a living room.
lines.zh: 家里有三间卧室、一间厨房和一间客厅。

lines.en: My favorite place is my bedroom, because it is quiet.
lines.zh: 我最喜欢的地方是我的卧室，因为那里很安静。

lines.en: There, I read books and do my homework by the window.
lines.zh: 在那里，我坐在窗边读书、写作业。

lines.en: In the evening, my family sits in the living room and talks.
lines.zh: 晚上，我们一家人坐在客厅里聊天。

lines.en: So our home is small, but it is full of love.
lines.zh: 所以我们的家虽然小，却充满了爱。

lines.en: That is why I love my home.
lines.zh: 这就是我爱我的家的原因。

patterns.en: My favorite room is my bedroom because it is quiet.
patterns.zh: 我最喜欢的房间是卧室，因为那里很安静。

patterns.en: My favorite room is the kitchen because it smells good.
patterns.zh: 我最喜欢的房间是厨房，因为那里闻起来很香。

patterns.en: My favorite room is the living room because my family is there.
patterns.zh: 我最喜欢的房间是客厅，因为家人都在那里。

patterns.en: I think a small, warm home is better than a big, cold one.
patterns.zh: 我觉得温暖的小家比冷冰冰的大房子更好。

lines.en: Good morning, everyone.
lines.zh: 大家早上好。

lines.en: How do you go to school every day?
lines.zh: 你每天怎样去上学？

lines.en: I used to go to school by car.
lines.zh: 我以前坐汽车上学。

lines.en: My dad took me every morning, but the roads were often busy.
lines.zh: 爸爸每天早上送我，但路上常常很堵。

lines.en: Sometimes we were late, and the car made the air dirty, too.
lines.zh: 有时我们会迟到，而且汽车还会污染空气。

lines.en: So last term, I started to go by bike.
lines.zh: 所以上学期，我开始骑自行车上学。

lines.en: It takes only fifteen minutes.
lines.zh: 只要十五分钟。

lines.en: Riding a bike is good for my body, and it is better for the air.
lines.zh: 骑自行车对我的身体有好处，对空气也更好。

lines.en: On rainy days, I take the bus instead.
lines.zh: 下雨天，我就改坐公交车。

lines.en: Now I am never late, and I feel stronger.
lines.zh: 现在我从不迟到，而且感觉更强壮了。

lines.en: So I think going by bike is the best way for me.
lines.zh: 所以我觉得骑自行车是最适合我的方式。

patterns.en: I go to school by bike because it is good for my health.
patterns.zh: 我骑自行车上学，因为这对我的健康有好处。

patterns.en: I go to school by bus because my home is far.
patterns.zh: 我坐公交车上学，因为我家很远。

patterns.en: I go to school on foot because my home is near.
patterns.zh: 我走路上学，因为我家很近。

patterns.en: I think going by bike is better than going by car.
patterns.zh: 我觉得骑自行车比坐汽车更好。

patterns.en: If it rains, I will take the bus.
patterns.zh: 如果下雨，我就坐公交车。

lines.en: Hello, boys and girls.
lines.zh: 同学们好。

lines.en: The summer holiday is coming.
lines.zh: 暑假就要到了。

lines.en: Let me tell you about my holiday plans.
lines.zh: 让我来说说我的假期计划。

lines.en: First, I am going to visit my grandparents in the country.
lines.zh: 首先，我要去乡下看望爷爷奶奶。

lines.en: They have a garden with many fruit trees, so I can help them pick fruit.
lines.zh: 他们有一个种满果树的园子，所以我可以帮他们摘水果。

lines.en: Then I am going to learn to swim in the river near their house.
lines.zh: 然后，我要在他们家附近的河里学游泳。

lines.en: In the evenings, I will read ten good books.
lines.zh: 晚上，我要读十本好书。

lines.en: If the weather is good, we will also go to the beach.
lines.zh: 如果天气好，我们还会去海边。

lines.en: If it rains, we will stay at home and play games.
lines.zh: 如果下雨，我们就待在家里玩游戏。

lines.en: I think it will be my best summer ever!
lines.zh: 我想这会是我过得最棒的一个夏天！

lines.en: What are you going to do this holiday?
lines.zh: 这个假期你打算做什么呢？

patterns.en: This holiday, I am going to visit my grandparents.
patterns.zh: 这个假期，我要去看望爷爷奶奶。

patterns.en: This holiday, I am going to learn to swim.
patterns.zh: 这个假期，我要学游泳。

patterns.en: This holiday, I am going to read ten books.
patterns.zh: 这个假期，我要读十本书。

patterns.en: If the weather is good, we will go to the beach.
patterns.zh: 如果天气好，我们就去海边。

patterns.en: If it rains, we will stay at home and play games.
patterns.zh: 如果下雨，我们就待在家里玩游戏。

lines.en: Hello, my friends.
lines.zh: 朋友们好。

lines.en: Last summer, my family and I went to the seaside.
lines.zh: 去年夏天，我和家人去了海边。

lines.en: We took the train, and it was a long trip.
lines.zh: 我们坐火车去，路途很长。

lines.en: But when I saw the blue sea, I forgot how tired I was.
lines.zh: 但看到蓝色的大海时，我忘记了疲惫。

lines.en: First, we went to the beach.
lines.zh: 首先，我们去了沙滩。

lines.en: The sand was soft and warm under my feet.
lines.zh: 脚下的沙子又软又暖。

lines.en: Then my sister and I made a big sand castle.
lines.zh: 然后，我和妹妹堆了一座大沙堡。

lines.en: After that, Dad taught me to swim in the sea.
lines.zh: 之后，爸爸教我在海里游泳。

lines.en: The water was cool, and the waves were big.
lines.zh: 海水凉凉的，浪很大。

lines.en: In the evening, we ate fresh fish at a small restaurant.
lines.zh: 晚上，我们在一家小餐馆吃了新鲜的鱼。

lines.en: Then we watched the sun go down over the sea.
lines.zh: 然后，我们看着太阳落到海面下。

lines.en: It was the most beautiful thing I have ever seen.
lines.zh: 那是我见过的最美的景色。

lines.en: I hope we can go there again next year.
lines.zh: 我希望明年还能再去那里。

patterns.en: Last summer, we went to the seaside by train.
patterns.zh: 去年夏天，我们坐火车去了海边。

patterns.en: Last winter, we went to Harbin by plane.
patterns.zh: 去年冬天，我们坐飞机去了哈尔滨。

patterns.en: If we go to the seaside again, I will swim every day.
patterns.zh: 如果我们再去海边，我要每天游泳。

patterns.en: I think the sea is more beautiful than a lake.
patterns.zh: 我觉得大海比湖更美。

patterns.en: Going by train is slower than going by plane, but it is more fun.
patterns.zh: 坐火车比坐飞机慢，但更有趣。

title: A Trip I Want to Take

lines.en: Good morning, everyone.
lines.zh: 大家早上好。

lines.en: Where do you want to go this summer?
lines.zh: 这个夏天你想去哪里？

lines.en: I want to go to Beijing with my family.
lines.zh: 我想和家人一起去北京。

lines.en: Beijing has a long history, and it is very beautiful.
lines.zh: 北京历史悠久，而且非常美丽。

lines.en: First, I am going to climb the Great Wall.
lines.zh: 首先，我要去爬长城。

lines.en: It is longer than any other wall in the world.
lines.zh: 它比世界上任何一道墙都长。

lines.en: Then I will go to the Palace Museum.
lines.zh: 然后我会去故宫博物院。

lines.en: In the past, the emperors of China lived there.
lines.zh: 在过去，中国的皇帝住在那里。

lines.en: After all that walking, I want to try the food there, like Beijing duck.
lines.zh: 走了那么多路以后，我想尝尝那里的美食，比如北京烤鸭。

lines.en: I will take many photos and send them to my friends.
lines.zh: 我会拍很多照片，发给我的朋友们。

lines.en: Then they can see Beijing, too.
lines.zh: 这样他们也能看到北京了。

lines.en: I think this will be a really great trip.
lines.zh: 我想这会是一次非常棒的旅行。

lines.en: I can't wait to go!
lines.zh: 我都等不及要出发了！

lines.en: Thank you for listening.
lines.zh: 谢谢大家的聆听。

patterns.en: I want to go to Beijing because I want to see the Great Wall.
patterns.zh: 我想去北京，因为我想看长城。

patterns.en: I want to go to the sea because I want to swim.
patterns.zh: 我想去海边，因为我想游泳。

patterns.en: I want to go to the north because I want to see the snow.
patterns.zh: 我想去北方，因为我想看雪。

patterns.en: When I get there, I am going to take many photos.
patterns.zh: 到了那里，我要拍很多照片。

patterns.en: The Great Wall is longer than any other wall in the world.
patterns.zh: 长城比世界上任何一道墙都长。

lines.en: Good morning, everyone.
lines.zh: 大家早上好。

lines.en: I want to tell you about my hometown.
lines.zh: 我想给大家介绍我的家乡。

lines.en: My hometown is a small town by a river.
lines.zh: 我的家乡是河边的一个小镇。

lines.en: It is not big, but it is very beautiful.
lines.zh: 它不大，但非常美丽。

lines.en: There are old bridges over the river and green trees along it.
lines.zh: 河上有古老的桥，河边是绿色的树。

lines.en: In spring, flowers open everywhere, and the air smells sweet.
lines.zh: 春天，到处开满鲜花，空气里都是香甜的味道。

lines.en: The people there are kind and friendly, too.
lines.zh: 那里的人也很善良友好。

lines.en: When I walk in the street, they always smile and say hello.
lines.zh: 我走在街上时，他们总是微笑着跟我打招呼。

lines.en: Now my hometown is getting cleaner and more beautiful every year.
lines.zh: 现在，我的家乡一年比一年干净、美丽。

lines.en: I love it, and I hope you can visit it one day.
lines.zh: 我爱我的家乡，希望有一天你也能去看看。

patterns.en: My hometown is small, but it is very beautiful.
patterns.zh: 我的家乡很小，但非常美丽。

patterns.en: My hometown is quieter than a big city.
patterns.zh: 我的家乡比大城市更安静。

patterns.en: I love my hometown because the people are friendly.
patterns.zh: 我爱我的家乡，因为那里的人很友好。

patterns.en: I love my hometown because the river is clean.
patterns.zh: 我爱我的家乡，因为那里的河很干净。

patterns.en: I think my hometown is more beautiful than before.
patterns.zh: 我觉得我的家乡比以前更美了。

lines.en: Good afternoon, everyone.
lines.zh: 大家下午好。

lines.en: Do you like the city or the country?
lines.zh: 你喜欢城市还是乡村？

lines.en: Some people like the city, but I like the country better.
lines.zh: 有些人喜欢城市，但我更喜欢乡村。

lines.en: First, the air in the country is cleaner.
lines.zh: 首先，乡村的空气更干净。

lines.en: That is because there are green fields, tall trees and clear rivers.
lines.zh: 那是因为那里有绿色的田野、高高的树和清澈的河流。

lines.en: Second, the country is quieter than the city.
lines.zh: 其次，乡村比城市更安静。

lines.en: At night, it is so quiet that I can see many stars in the sky.
lines.zh: 晚上，那里安静极了，我能看到满天的星星。

lines.en: Of course, the city has big shops and fast trains.
lines.zh: 当然，城市里有大商店和快速的火车。

lines.en: But I think life in the country is happier.
lines.zh: 但我觉得乡村的生活更快乐。

lines.en: That is why I love the country.
lines.zh: 这就是我爱乡村的原因。

lines.en: Thank you for listening.
lines.zh: 谢谢大家的聆听。

patterns.en: I think the country is quieter than the city.
patterns.zh: 我觉得乡村比城市更安静。

patterns.en: I think the air in the country is cleaner than in the city.
patterns.zh: 我觉得乡村的空气比城市的更干净。

patterns.en: I think the city is busier than the country.
patterns.zh: 我觉得城市比乡村更热闹。

patterns.en: I think the shops in the city are bigger than in the country.
patterns.zh: 我觉得城市的商店比乡村的更大。

patterns.en: I like the country better because it is green and quiet.
patterns.zh: 我更喜欢乡村，因为那里绿色又安静。

lines.en: Good morning, everyone.
lines.zh: 大家早上好。

lines.en: Is there a library in your city?
lines.zh: 你们的城市有图书馆吗？

lines.en: There is a big one near my home, and I go there every weekend.
lines.zh: 我家附近有一座大图书馆，我每个周末都去。

lines.en: The first time I went there, I was really surprised.
lines.zh: 第一次去那里时，我真的很惊讶。

lines.en: There were thousands of books, from story books to science books.
lines.zh: 那里有成千上万本书，从故事书到科学书都有。

lines.en: There was also a quiet reading room just for children.
lines.zh: 那里还有一间专门给孩子们的安静阅览室。

lines.en: Best of all, we can take the books home for free.
lines.zh: 最棒的是，我们可以免费把书借回家。

lines.en: But to keep the library nice, there are some rules.
lines.zh: 但为了让图书馆保持美好，这里有一些规则。

lines.en: We must be quiet, and we must not eat or drink there.
lines.zh: 我们必须保持安静，不能在里面吃喝。

lines.en: We should also take good care of the books and bring them back on time.
lines.zh: 我们还应该爱护图书，按时归还。

lines.en: That is why I think the library is the best place in my city.
lines.zh: 所以我觉得图书馆是我们城市最好的地方。

lines.en: Why not visit your library this weekend?
lines.zh: 这个周末何不去你们的图书馆看看？

patterns.en: I go to the library because the books are free.
patterns.zh: 我去图书馆，因为那里的书是免费的。

patterns.en: I go to the park because the air is fresh.
patterns.zh: 我去公园，因为那里空气清新。

patterns.en: I go to the museum because I like history.
patterns.zh: 我去博物馆，因为我喜欢历史。

patterns.en: In the library, we must be quiet.
patterns.zh: 在图书馆里，我们必须保持安静。

patterns.en: I think reading in the library is better than reading at home.
patterns.zh: 我觉得在图书馆读书比在家读书更好。

lines.en: Good afternoon, boys and girls.
lines.zh: 同学们，下午好。

lines.en: Our city is our big home, and we share it with many people.
lines.zh: 城市是我们的大家庭，我们和很多人共享它。

lines.en: So we should have good manners in public places.
lines.zh: 所以在公共场所我们应该讲文明。

lines.en: For example, on the bus, we should give our seats to old people.
lines.zh: 比如，在公交车上，我们应该给老人让座。

lines.en: In the park, we should not pick the flowers or walk on the grass.
lines.zh: 在公园里，我们不应该摘花或踩草坪。

lines.en: In the cinema, we should turn off our phones and not talk loudly.
lines.zh: 在电影院里，我们应该关掉手机，不大声说话。

lines.en: And everywhere, we should put rubbish in the bins.
lines.zh: 而且无论在哪里，我们都应该把垃圾扔进垃圾桶。

lines.en: Last week, I saw a boy drop a bottle on the street.
lines.zh: 上个星期，我看到一个男孩把瓶子扔在街上。

lines.en: An old man picked it up and put it in the bin.
lines.zh: 一位老爷爷把它捡起来，扔进了垃圾桶。

lines.en: The boy's face turned red, and he said sorry.
lines.zh: 男孩的脸红了，他说了声对不起。

lines.en: If everyone has good manners, our city will be cleaner and friendlier.
lines.zh: 如果每个人都讲文明，我们的城市就会更干净、更友好。

lines.en: So let's start with ourselves!
lines.zh: 所以，让我们从自己做起！

patterns.en: On the bus, we should give our seats to old people.
patterns.zh: 在公交车上，我们应该给老人让座。

patterns.en: In the park, we should not pick the flowers.
patterns.zh: 在公园里，我们不应该摘花。

patterns.en: In the cinema, we should not talk loudly.
patterns.zh: 在电影院里，我们不应该大声说话。

patterns.en: If everyone has good manners, our city will be nicer.
patterns.zh: 如果每个人都讲文明，我们的城市就会更美好。

patterns.en: I think saying sorry is better than saying nothing.
patterns.zh: 我觉得说声对不起比什么都不说更好。

lines.en: Good morning, boys and girls.
lines.zh: 同学们，早上好。

lines.en: Every day, we go to school by bus, by bike or on foot.
lines.zh: 每天，我们坐公交车、骑自行车或步行去上学。

lines.en: So we must be safe on the road.
lines.zh: 所以我们在路上一定要注意安全。

lines.en: First, we should always walk on the side of the road.
lines.zh: 首先，我们应该一直靠路边走。

lines.en: When we cross the road, we should use the zebra crossing.
lines.zh: 过马路时，我们应该走斑马线。

lines.en: And we must wait for the green light.
lines.zh: 而且我们一定要等绿灯。

lines.en: Red means stop, and green means go.
lines.zh: 红灯停，绿灯行。

lines.en: Also, we should never play on the road.
lines.zh: 还有，我们绝不能在马路上玩耍。

lines.en: Last week, I saw a boy run across the road at a red light.
lines.zh: 上个星期，我看到一个男孩闯红灯跑过马路。

lines.en: A car stopped just in time, and I was really afraid.
lines.zh: 一辆汽车及时停了下来，我真的吓坏了。

lines.en: He was lucky, but we may not be so lucky.
lines.zh: 他很幸运，但我们未必会那么幸运。

lines.en: So if we follow the rules, we will be safe.
lines.zh: 所以，只要我们遵守规则，就会平安。

lines.en: Let's be safe on the road every day!
lines.zh: 让我们每天都注意交通安全！

patterns.en: We should wait for the green light because it is safe.
patterns.zh: 我们应该等绿灯，因为这样才安全。

patterns.en: We should walk on the side of the road because cars are fast.
patterns.zh: 我们应该靠路边走，因为汽车开得很快。

patterns.en: If we follow the rules, we will be safe.
patterns.zh: 如果我们遵守规则，就会平安。

patterns.en: If we play on the road, we may get hurt.
patterns.zh: 如果我们在马路上玩，可能会受伤。

patterns.en: I think waiting for the green light is better than running across the road.
patterns.zh: 我觉得等绿灯比跑着过马路更好。

lines.en: Good morning, everyone.
lines.zh: 大家早上好。

lines.en: Today I want to talk about my dream job.
lines.zh: 今天我想谈谈我的梦想职业。

lines.en: When I grow up, I want to be a doctor.
lines.zh: 长大后，我想当一名医生。

lines.en: I want to be a doctor because of my grandma.
lines.zh: 我想当医生，是因为我的奶奶。

lines.en: Last year, she was very ill.
lines.zh: 去年，她病得很重。

lines.en: A kind doctor looked after her every day.
lines.zh: 一位好心的医生每天照顾她。

lines.en: Slowly, she got well again.
lines.zh: 慢慢地，她又好起来了。

lines.en: Then I thought, "I want to help people like that doctor."
lines.zh: 那时我想：“我也要像那位医生一样帮助别人。”

lines.en: So now I study hard every day for my dream.
lines.zh: 所以现在我每天都为了梦想努力学习。

lines.en: Thank you for listening.
lines.zh: 谢谢大家的聆听。

patterns.en: I want to be a doctor because I want to help people.
patterns.zh: 我想当医生，因为我想帮助别人。

patterns.en: I want to be a teacher because I love children.
patterns.zh: 我想当老师，因为我喜欢孩子。

patterns.en: I want to be a farmer because I love plants.
patterns.zh: 我想当农民，因为我喜欢植物。

patterns.en: I want to be a cook because I like making good food.
patterns.zh: 我想当厨师，因为我喜欢做好吃的饭菜。

lines.en: Good morning, everyone.
lines.zh: 大家早上好。

lines.en: Today I want to tell you about my dad's job.
lines.zh: 今天我想给大家讲讲我爸爸的工作。

lines.en: My dad is a bus driver in our city.
lines.zh: 我爸爸是我们城市的一名公交车司机。

lines.en: Every day, he gets up at five o'clock.
lines.zh: 他每天五点钟起床。

lines.en: Then he drives a big green bus from one end of the city to the other.
lines.zh: 然后，他开着一辆绿色的大公交车，从城市的一头开到另一头。

lines.en: Many people take his bus to work or to school.
lines.zh: 很多人坐他的车去上班或上学。

lines.en: His job is not easy, because he must be careful all day.
lines.zh: 他的工作不轻松，因为他一整天都必须小心。

lines.en: Last Saturday, my mom and I took his bus.
lines.zh: 上个星期六，我和妈妈坐了他开的车。

lines.en: I saw him help an old woman get on the bus.
lines.zh: 我看到他帮一位老奶奶上车。

lines.en: At that moment, I was very proud of him.
lines.zh: 那一刻，我为他感到非常骄傲。

lines.en: I think bus drivers are important, because they help a whole city move.
lines.zh: 我觉得公交车司机很重要，因为他们让整座城市运转起来。

patterns.en: My dad is a bus driver, and he helps people go to work.
patterns.zh: 我爸爸是公交车司机，他帮助人们去上班。

patterns.en: My mom is a nurse, and she helps people who are ill.
patterns.zh: 我妈妈是护士，她帮助生病的人。

patterns.en: My uncle is a cook, and he makes delicious food.
patterns.zh: 我叔叔是厨师，他做好吃的饭菜。

patterns.en: I think a bus driver's job is harder than it looks.
patterns.zh: 我觉得公交车司机的工作比看上去更辛苦。

patterns.en: If there were no bus drivers, many people could not go to work.
patterns.zh: 如果没有公交车司机，很多人就没法去上班。

lines.en: Good morning, boys and girls.
lines.zh: 同学们，早上好。

lines.en: Every day, many people help us, but we often do not see them.
lines.zh: 每天都有很多人在帮助我们，但我们常常看不到他们。

lines.en: Let me tell you about some of them.
lines.zh: 让我来介绍其中的一些人。

lines.en: Early in the morning, street cleaners clean our streets.
lines.zh: 清晨，环卫工人打扫我们的街道。

lines.en: Because of them, our city is clean when we wake up.
lines.zh: 因为有他们，我们醒来时城市已经干干净净。

lines.en: During the day, police officers keep our roads safe.
lines.zh: 白天，警察守护着道路的安全。

lines.en: They help children cross the road and help people who are lost.
lines.zh: 他们帮助孩子们过马路，帮助迷路的人。

lines.en: When there is a fire, firefighters come very quickly.
lines.zh: 发生火灾时，消防员会很快赶到。

lines.en: They are very brave, because their job can be dangerous.
lines.zh: 他们非常勇敢，因为他们的工作可能很危险。

lines.en: And when we are ill, doctors and nurses look after us.
lines.zh: 当我们生病时，医生和护士照顾我们。

lines.en: So next time you see these people, please say "Thank you."
lines.zh: 所以下次见到这些人，请对他们说声“谢谢”。

lines.en: Their work makes our lives better every day.
lines.zh: 他们的工作每天都让我们的生活更美好。

patterns.en: Police officers are important because they keep us safe.
patterns.zh: 警察很重要，因为他们保护我们的安全。

patterns.en: Firefighters are brave because they put out fires.
patterns.zh: 消防员很勇敢，因为他们扑灭火灾。

patterns.en: Street cleaners are helpful because they keep our city clean.
patterns.zh: 环卫工人很有帮助，因为他们让城市保持干净。

patterns.en: If we are lost, we can ask a police officer for help.
patterns.zh: 如果我们迷路了，可以向警察求助。

patterns.en: I think firefighters are braver than anyone.
patterns.zh: 我觉得消防员比谁都勇敢。

title: A Day in a Farmer's Life

lines.en: Good afternoon, everyone.
lines.zh: 大家下午好。

lines.en: Have you ever thought about where our food comes from?
lines.zh: 你有没有想过我们的食物是从哪里来的？

lines.en: Last summer, I spent a day with my uncle, who is a farmer.
lines.zh: 去年夏天，我和当农民的叔叔一起过了一天。

lines.en: His day starts very early, at about five in the morning.
lines.zh: 他的一天开始得很早，大约早上五点。

lines.en: First, he feeds the chickens and the cows.
lines.zh: 首先，他喂鸡和牛。

lines.en: Then he goes to the fields to water the vegetables.
lines.zh: 然后，他去田里给蔬菜浇水。

lines.en: At noon, the sun is very hot, so he rests under a tree.
lines.zh: 中午太阳很毒，所以他在树下休息。

lines.en: In the afternoon, he picks tomatoes and puts them in big boxes.
lines.zh: 下午，他摘西红柿，把它们装进大箱子里。

lines.en: I helped him, and soon my back hurt.
lines.zh: 我帮他一起干，很快我的腰就酸了。

lines.en: In the evening, he takes the vegetables to the market.
lines.zh: 傍晚，他把蔬菜运到市场。

lines.en: He was tired, but he smiled and said, "People will have fresh food tomorrow."
lines.zh: 他很累，但笑着说：“明天大家就有新鲜的菜吃了。”

lines.en: After that day, I never waste food.
lines.zh: 从那天起，我再也不浪费食物了。

lines.en: Farmers work so hard, so let's thank them for every meal.
lines.zh: 农民这么辛苦，让我们为每一餐感谢他们。

patterns.en: A farmer gets up early because there is a lot of work.
patterns.zh: 农民起得很早，因为有很多活要干。

patterns.en: A cook works in a kitchen because he makes food for people.
patterns.zh: 厨师在厨房工作，因为他为人们做饭。

patterns.en: If farmers did not work hard, we would have no food.
patterns.zh: 如果农民不辛勤劳动，我们就没有食物。

patterns.en: I think a farmer's job is harder than many other jobs.
patterns.zh: 我觉得农民的工作比很多其他工作都辛苦。

patterns.en: We should thank farmers because they grow our food.
patterns.zh: 我们应该感谢农民，因为他们种出了我们的食物。

lines.en: Hello, my friends.
lines.zh: 朋友们好。

lines.en: What jobs will people do in the future?
lines.zh: 将来人们会做什么样的工作？

lines.en: I think the world will be very different when we grow up.
lines.zh: 我觉得等我们长大时，世界会变得很不一样。

lines.en: For example, robots will do many jobs for us.
lines.zh: 比如，机器人会替我们做很多工作。

lines.en: They will drive cars, cook food and clean our homes.
lines.zh: 它们会开车、做饭、打扫房子。

lines.en: But that does not mean people will have nothing to do.
lines.zh: 但这并不意味着人们会无事可做。

lines.en: Instead, there will be many new jobs.
lines.zh: 相反，会出现很多新的职业。

lines.en: Some people will make robots and teach them new things.
lines.zh: 有些人会制造机器人，教它们新本领。

lines.en: Some people will work in space, or even live on the moon.
lines.zh: 有些人会在太空工作，甚至住在月球上。

lines.en: Others will help keep our earth clean and green.
lines.zh: 还有些人会帮助地球保持清洁和绿色。

lines.en: I want to be a space scientist in the future.
lines.zh: 将来我想成为一名太空科学家。

lines.en: I hope to build a new home for people on the moon.
lines.zh: 我希望在月球上为人们建造新的家园。

lines.en: To do that, I must study science and math very hard now.
lines.zh: 为了做到这一点，我现在必须努力学习科学和数学。

lines.en: Thank you for listening.
lines.zh: 谢谢大家的聆听。

patterns.en: In the future, robots will clean our homes.
patterns.zh: 将来，机器人会打扫我们的房子。

patterns.en: In the future, people will live on the moon.
patterns.zh: 将来，人们会住在月球上。

patterns.en: In the future, I will be a space scientist.
patterns.zh: 将来，我会成为一名太空科学家。

patterns.en: If I study hard now, I will get a good job in the future.
patterns.zh: 如果我现在努力学习，将来就能找到好工作。

patterns.en: I think working with robots will be more exciting than working alone.
patterns.zh: 我觉得和机器人一起工作会比独自工作更令人兴奋。

lines.en: Hello, my dear friends.
lines.zh: 亲爱的朋友们，你们好。

lines.en: Last Sunday was my tenth birthday.
lines.zh: 上个星期天是我十岁的生日。

lines.en: My parents had a party for me at home.
lines.zh: 爸爸妈妈在家里为我办了一个派对。

lines.en: I asked five of my friends to come.
lines.zh: 我请了五个朋友来参加。

lines.en: Mom made a big chocolate cake with ten candles on it.
lines.zh: 妈妈做了一个大巧克力蛋糕，上面插着十根蜡烛。

lines.en: When my friends sang "Happy Birthday" to me, I made a wish.
lines.zh: 朋友们为我唱《生日快乐》时，我许了一个愿。

lines.en: Then I put out all the candles at one time.
lines.zh: 然后我一口气吹灭了所有的蜡烛。

lines.en: After that, my friends gave me a book, a kite and a funny card.
lines.zh: 之后，朋友们送给我一本书、一只风筝和一张有趣的卡片。

lines.en: We ate the cake, played games and laughed a lot.
lines.zh: 我们吃蛋糕、玩游戏，笑个不停。

lines.en: It was the happiest birthday of my life.
lines.zh: 那是我过得最快乐的一个生日。

lines.en: Thank you, my friends, for making it so special.
lines.zh: 谢谢你们，我的朋友们，让这个生日如此特别。

patterns.en: On my birthday, I want to have a party with my friends.
patterns.zh: 生日那天，我想和朋友们开派对。

patterns.en: On my birthday, I want to eat a chocolate cake.
patterns.zh: 生日那天，我想吃巧克力蛋糕。

patterns.en: On my birthday, I want to get a new book.
patterns.zh: 生日那天，我想得到一本新书。

patterns.en: I think a party with friends is better than a big present.
patterns.zh: 我觉得和朋友们开派对比一份大礼物更好。

patterns.en: If you come to my party, we will have a lot of fun.
patterns.zh: 如果你来参加我的派对，我们会玩得很开心。

lines.en: Good morning, everyone.
lines.zh: 大家早上好。

lines.en: Do you know which day is the happiest day for children?
lines.zh: 你知道哪一天是孩子们最快乐的日子吗？

lines.en: I think it is Children's Day, on the first of June.
lines.zh: 我觉得是六月一日的儿童节。

lines.en: On that day, we do not have lessons at school.
lines.zh: 那天，我们在学校不用上课。

lines.en: Instead, our school has a big show.
lines.zh: 取而代之的是，学校会举办一场大型演出。

lines.en: Last year, my friends and I did a dance in the show.
lines.zh: 去年，我和朋友们在演出中表演了一支舞。

lines.en: We practiced for two weeks before that day.
lines.zh: 在那之前，我们练习了两个星期。

lines.en: At first, I was shy and afraid.
lines.zh: 一开始，我又害羞又害怕。

lines.en: But on the day of the show, I danced very well.
lines.zh: 但到了演出那天，我跳得非常好。

lines.en: Our parents came to watch us, and they were very proud.
lines.zh: 爸爸妈妈来看我们表演，他们非常自豪。

lines.en: In the afternoon, we played games and ate ice cream together.
lines.zh: 下午，我们一起玩游戏、吃冰淇淋。

lines.en: That is why Children's Day is my favorite day of the year!
lines.zh: 这就是为什么儿童节是我一年中最喜欢的日子！

patterns.en: On Children's Day, we will have a big show.
patterns.zh: 儿童节那天，我们会有一场大型演出。

patterns.en: On Children's Day, we will play games at school.
patterns.zh: 儿童节那天，我们会在学校玩游戏。

patterns.en: On Children's Day, I am going to dance with my friends.
patterns.zh: 儿童节那天，我要和朋友们一起跳舞。

patterns.en: If we practice hard, the show will be great.
patterns.zh: 如果我们努力练习，演出就会很精彩。

patterns.en: I think Children's Day is more fun than other days.
patterns.zh: 我觉得儿童节比其他日子更有趣。

lines.en: Good morning, boys and girls.
lines.zh: 同学们，早上好。

lines.en: China has many great festivals.
lines.zh: 中国有很多很棒的节日。

lines.en: Let me talk about three of them.
lines.zh: 让我来介绍其中的三个。

lines.en: The first one is the Spring Festival, the most important festival in China.
lines.zh: 第一个是春节，它是中国最重要的节日。

lines.en: At that time, families get together for a special meal.
lines.zh: 那时，一家人团聚在一起，吃一顿特别的饭。

lines.en: Children also get red packets with money in them.
lines.zh: 孩子们还会收到装着钱的红包。

lines.en: A few months later comes the Dragon Boat Festival.
lines.zh: 几个月后，就到了端午节。

lines.en: On that day, we eat rice dumplings and watch the boat races.
lines.zh: 那天，我们吃粽子，看龙舟比赛。

lines.en: Then, in autumn, we have the Mid-Autumn Festival.
lines.zh: 然后，在秋天，我们过中秋节。

lines.en: On that night, the moon is round and bright.
lines.zh: 那天晚上，月亮又圆又亮。

lines.en: We eat mooncakes and look at the moon with our family.
lines.zh: 我们和家人一起吃月饼、赏月。

lines.en: Of the three, I like the Spring Festival best, because I can see all my family.
lines.zh: 三个节日中，我最喜欢春节，因为我能见到全家人。

lines.en: Which festival do you like best?
lines.zh: 你最喜欢哪个节日呢？

patterns.en: I like the Spring Festival best because I can see all my family.
patterns.zh: 我最喜欢春节，因为我能见到全家人。

patterns.en: I like the Dragon Boat Festival best because I love rice dumplings.
patterns.zh: 我最喜欢端午节，因为我爱吃粽子。

patterns.en: I like the Mid-Autumn Festival best because the moon is beautiful.
patterns.zh: 我最喜欢中秋节，因为月亮很美。

patterns.en: On the Mid-Autumn Festival, the moon is brighter than on other nights.
patterns.zh: 中秋节的月亮比其他夜晚更亮。

patterns.en: I think the Spring Festival is the most important festival.
patterns.zh: 我认为春节是最重要的节日。

lines.en: Good morning, dear teachers and friends.
lines.zh: 亲爱的老师们、同学们，早上好。

lines.en: I am ten years old now, and I am growing up every day.
lines.zh: 我现在十岁了，每天都在长大。

lines.en: When I was little, I could not do many things on my own.
lines.zh: 小时候，很多事情我都不能自己做。

lines.en: My mom had to help me with almost everything.
lines.zh: 妈妈几乎什么事都得帮我。

lines.en: But now I can do many things by myself.
lines.zh: 但现在，很多事情我都能自己做了。

lines.en: For example, I can make my bed, cook eggs and take the bus to school.
lines.zh: 比如，我会整理床铺、煮鸡蛋，还能自己坐公交车上学。

lines.en: Of course, growing up is not always easy.
lines.zh: 当然，长大并不总是容易的。

lines.en: Sometimes I make mistakes, and sometimes I feel sad.
lines.zh: 有时我会犯错，有时我会难过。

lines.en: But every mistake teaches me something new.
lines.zh: 但每一次犯错都让我学到新东西。

lines.en: I also know that I should help others, not only myself.
lines.zh: 我也明白了，我应该帮助别人，而不只是顾着自己。

lines.en: So I think growing up is exciting.
lines.zh: 所以我觉得长大是一件令人兴奋的事。

lines.en: Next year, I will be taller, braver and wiser.
lines.zh: 明年，我会更高、更勇敢、更懂事。

lines.en: Thank you for listening.
lines.zh: 谢谢大家的聆听。

patterns.en: When I was little, I could not ride a bike.
patterns.zh: 小时候，我不会骑自行车。

patterns.en: Now I can ride a bike on my own.
patterns.zh: 现在我能自己骑自行车了。

patterns.en: When I grow up, I will be braver than now.
patterns.zh: 长大后，我会比现在更勇敢。

patterns.en: I think growing up is exciting because I can learn new things.
patterns.zh: 我觉得长大很令人兴奋，因为我能学到新东西。

patterns.en: If I keep trying, I will do better every year.
patterns.zh: 如果我坚持努力，就会一年比一年好。

lines.en: Good morning, everyone.
lines.zh: 大家早上好。

lines.en: Time goes so quickly, and this school year is almost over.
lines.zh: 时间过得真快，这个学年快要结束了。

lines.en: Today I want to look back on this year.
lines.zh: 今天我想回顾一下这一年。

lines.en: This year, I learned many new things.
lines.zh: 这一年，我学到了很多新东西。

lines.en: For example, my English is much better than last year.
lines.zh: 比如，我的英语比去年好多了。

lines.en: Now I can even give a short talk in English, like this one.
lines.zh: 现在我甚至能用英语做一个简短的演讲，就像现在这样。

lines.en: I also made new friends when I joined the art club.
lines.zh: 参加美术社团后，我还交了新朋友。

lines.en: But not every day was happy.
lines.zh: 但并不是每一天都快乐。

lines.en: I lost a race on Sports Day, and I was very sad.
lines.zh: 我在运动会上输了一场赛跑，非常难过。

lines.en: I did not give up, so I kept running every morning after that.
lines.zh: 我没有放弃，从那以后每天早上都坚持跑步。

lines.en: All these things made me stronger and braver.
lines.zh: 所有这些经历让我变得更强大、更勇敢。

lines.en: Next year, I am going to read more books and help others.
lines.zh: 明年，我要读更多的书，并且帮助别人。

lines.en: I think next year will be even better.
lines.zh: 我相信明年会更好。

lines.en: Thank you all for a happy year!
lines.zh: 谢谢大家陪我度过快乐的一年！

patterns.en: This year, I learned to swim, and I am happy about it.
patterns.zh: 这一年，我学会了游泳，我为此感到高兴。

patterns.en: My English is better than last year.
patterns.zh: 我的英语比去年更好了。

patterns.en: I am braver than before because I did not give up.
patterns.zh: 我比以前更勇敢了，因为我没有放弃。

patterns.en: Next year, I am going to read more books.
patterns.zh: 明年，我要读更多的书。

patterns.en: If I keep working hard, next year will be even better.
patterns.zh: 如果我继续努力，明年会更好。
